column1: See CHECK in the top bar? It only appears when something is wrong. Press it.
column2: Uyambona u-CHECK ebhayini eliphezulu? Uvela kuphela uma kukhona okungalungile. Mcindezele.

column1: It lists everything a show would trip over: missing files, empty cues, unreachable outputs.
column2: Ubala konke umbukiso obungakhubeka kukho: amafayela angekho, ama-cue angenalutho, okuphumayo okungafinyeleleki.

column1: The intro video is on another computer. Select it and delete it, or RELINK it if you have the file.
column2: Ividiyo yokuqala isekhompyutheni ehlukile. Yikhethe uyisule, noma wenze u-RELINK uma unefayela.

column1: Fix it at home, where it is easy. Not at the venue, where it is not.
column2: Yilungise ekhaya, lapho kulula khona. Hhayi endaweni yomcimbi, lapho kungelula khona.

column1: Press BUNDLE and choose where: a USB stick, a shared folder. The show and all its media, together.
column2: Cindezela u-HLANGANISA ukhethe lapho: i-USB stick, ifolda okwabelwana ngayo. Umbukiso nayo yonke imidiya yawo, ndawonye.

column1: The copy finds its media beside it, wherever the folder goes.
column2: Ikhophi ithola imidiya yayo eceleni kwayo, noma ifolda iyaphi.

column1: Checked, fixed, bundled. On the other machine, open the bundle's show: everything is where it should be.
column2: Kuhloliwe, kulungisiwe, kuhlanganisiwe. Kumshini omunye, vula umbukiso wephakethe: konke kusendaweni yakho.

column1: A show file is only text, so it travels light. The media is the heavy part.
column2: Ifayela lombukiso ngumbhalo nje, ngakho lihamba lilula. Okusindayo yimidiya.

column1: An art school, skapi. One student, one picture, one critic who has seen it all. Press START.
column2: Isikole sobuciko, skapi. Umfundi oyedwa, isithombe esisodwa, umgxeki oyedwa osebone konke. Cindezela u-START.

column1: Effects change a picture; an oscillator keeps changing it. The critic only likes the second kind.
column2: Imiphumela ishintsha isithombe; i-oscillator iqhubeka isishintsha. Umgxeki uthanda uhlobo lwesibili kuphela.

column1: A grey square on beige. I have seen this at every graduate show since 1987.
column2: Isikwele esimpunga phezu kwe-beige. Ngikubone lokhu kuyo yonke imibukiso yokuphothula kusukela ngo-1987.

column1: In the inspector's EFFECTS section, + adds one. Edges is a good start: it draws the outlines.
column2: Esigabeni se-EFFECTS se-inspector, u-+ wengeza owodwa. U-Edges uyisiqalo esihle: udweba imiphetho.

column1: There are dozens. Every one runs on the CPU in a few milliseconds. Mostly.
column2: Ziningi. Ngayinye isebenza ku-CPU ngama-millisecond ambalwa. Ngokuvamile.

column1: Take a risk! Bad art is fine. Boring art is a crime.
column2: Zama! Ubuciko obubi bulungile. Ubuciko obuyisicefe buyicala.

column1: Every control with a ~ beside it can follow an oscillator. Press one. The knob starts to breathe.
column2: Noma yisiphi isilawuli esino-~ eceleni singalandela i-oscillator. Cindezela esisodwa. Inkinobho iqala ukuphefumula.

column1: A low-frequency oscillator: slow, so the eye can follow it. A quarter of a hertz is a four-second breath.
column2: I-oscillator ye-frequency ephansi: ihamba kancane, ukuze iso liyilandele. Ingxenye yesine ye-hertz ingumoya wemizuzwana emine.

column1: Now it MOVES. Okay. Okay. I'm listening.
Effects that draw a colour, like Edges' line, have a colour chip. It opens the picker: a wheel, typed names, or a colour off the screen.
column2: Imiphumela edweba umbala, njengomugqa ka-Edges, inesigcawu sombala. Sivula isikhethi: isondo, amagama abhaliwe, noma umbala osuka esikrinini.

column1: Every colour has a name somewhere. Mine is 'oscilloscope green'. Nobody else uses it.
column2: Wonke umbala unegama kwenye indawo. Owami ngu-'luhlaza lwe-oscilloscope'. Akekho omunye owusebenzisayo.

column1: That colour is doing something. I don't know what. I love it.
column2: Lowo mbala wenza okuthile. Angazi ukuthi yini. Ngiyawuthanda.

column1: An effect, a ~ and a colour. The critic is crying, skapi. Good crying, I think.
column2: Umphumela, u-~ nombala. Umgxeki uyakhala, skapi. Ukukhala okuhle, ngicabanga.

column1: Stack a few. Each has its own ~ on every knob. That is how a look becomes a performance.
column2: Beka ezimbalwa phezu kwezinye. Ngayinye ino-~ wayo kuyo yonke inkinobho. Yilokho okwenza ukubukeka kube ngumdlalo.

column1: It's still a square. But it's YOUR square. Post it.
column2: Kusese yisikwele. Kodwa yisikwele SAKHO. Sithumele.

column1: Coach Marv explains sport by drawing circles on it. Once he circled the sun. Ten minutes, skapi.
column2: UCoach Marv uchaza ezemidlalo ngokudweba izindingilizi phezu kwayo. Ngelinye ilanga wazungeza ilanga. Imizuzu eyishumi, skapi.

column1: Tonight: test patterns, the video synth, and drawing on the picture. Press START.
column2: Namhlanje ebusuku: amaphethini okuhlola, i-video synth, nokudweba esithombeni. Cindezela u-START.

column1: Get me a picture and a pen. BOOM.
Line up the screens BEFORE the show. Not during. I learned this in Plovdiv.
column2: Qondanisa izikrini NGAPHAMBI kombukiso. Hhayi phakathi. Lokhu ngakufunda ePlovdiv.

column1: Every desk needs a test pattern. PATTERN adds Pocket Test: checked against real meters.
column2: Yonke ideski idinga iphethini yokuhlola. U-IPHETHINI wengeza u-Pocket Test: ihlolwe ngamamitha angempela.

column1: He says 'no camera needed' like it is a feature. It is a feature.
My favourite. SOURCE, then Video Synth: oscillators, mirrors and feedback. No camera needed.
column2: Engiyithanda kakhulu. U-UMTHOMBO, bese u-Video Synth: ama-oscillator, izibuko ne-feedback. Akudingeki ikhamera.

column1: Select it, then TAKE. Confident operators press Enter.
column2: Yikhethe, bese u-TAKE. Abasebenzisi abazethembayo bacindezela u-Enter.

column1: That's our replay. Every replay needs a pundit.
column2: Yile i-replay yethu. Yonke i-replay idinga umhlaziyi.

column1: Now here's a replay. And here's a guy. And BOOM, he's in it.
column2: Nansi i-replay. Nanku umdlali. Futhi BHUM, ungaphakathi.

column1: Ink goes on top, on its own layer. Press the + at the end of the playlist tabs.
column2: Uyinki uya phezulu, ku-layer yawo. Cindezela u-+ ekugcineni kwamathebhu e-playlist.

column1: A second playlist is a layer over the first. Like a second oscillator, mixed on top.
column2: I-playlist yesibili iyi-layer phezu kweyokuqala. Njenge-oscillator yesibili, exutshwe phezulu.

column1: In the new playlist: SOURCE, then Draw. Clear everywhere you have not drawn.
column2: Ku-playlist entsha: u-UMTHOMBO, bese u-Draw. Kucacile yonke indawo ongadwebanga kuyo.

column1: A Draw cue is transparent outside the ink, so the synth shows through.
column2: I-cue ka-Draw icacile ngaphandle koyinki, ngakho i-synth ibonakala ngemuva.

column1: Select the Draw cue and TAKE it. Two playlists, two layers, one picture.
column2: Khetha i-cue ka-Draw wenze u-TAKE. Ama-playlist amabili, ama-layer amabili, isithombe esisodwa.

column1: Now both are live: the synth underneath, the ink on top.
column2: Manje zombili zisemoyeni: i-synth ngaphansi, uyinki phezulu.

column1: Press DRAW in the inspector, then draw on the programme monitor. Mouse, or a pen if you have one.
column2: Cindezela u-DRAW ku-inspector, bese udweba ku-monitor yohlelo. Nge-mouse, noma ngepeni uma unalo.

column1: A pen's pressure makes the line thicker. A mouse presses at one strength. Like me.
column2: Ukucindezela kwepeni kwenza umugqa ujiye. I-mouse icindezela ngamandla afanayo njalo. Njengami.

column1: Circle him! No, bigger. BOOM. That's a cloud. Fine. Circle the cloud.
column2: Mzungeze! Cha, kakhudlwana. BHUM. Lelo yifu. Kulungile. Zungeza ifu.

column1: SAVE STILL keeps the drawing as a picture with a clear background, and adds it to the playlist.
column2: U-SAVE STILL ugcina umdwebo njengesithombe esinengemuva elicacile, awufake ku-playlist.

column1: For next week's show. Coach Marv will want the cloud again.
column2: Kohlelo lwesonto elizayo. UCoach Marv uzolifuna futhi ifu.

column1: Patterns, the synth, a layer, ink, a still. Nazdrave, skapi.
column2: Amaphethini, i-synth, i-layer, uyinki, isithombe esimile. Nazdrave, skapi.

column1: Try Replay in the Draw section: it draws your lines back the way you drew them.
column2: Zama u-Replay esigabeni sika-Draw: uphinda adwebe imigqa yakho njengoba wayidweba.

column1: Same time next week. Bring a bigger pen. And a turducken.
column2: Isikhathi esifanayo ngesonto elizayo. Letha ipeni elikhulu. Nebhodwe lephaphu nenyama.

column1: The Bureau of Unexplained Signals. Two agents, one photo, and it must not air. Press START.
column2: Ihhovisi Lezignali Ezingachazeki. Ama-ejenti amabili, isithombe esisodwa, futhi akumele siye emoyeni. Cindezela u-START.

column1: Masks cut a picture into shapes. Tonight we cut evidence.
column2: Ama-mask asika isithombe abe yizimo. Namhlanje ebusuku sisika ubufakazi.

column1: That's a craft, Brandt. Look at the lights. I want to believe.
column2: Leyo yimikhumbi-mkhathi, Brandt. Bheka izibani. Ngifuna ukukholwa.

column1: In the inspector's MASK section: mask, then 'new heart'. Any shape will do. The heart is funnier.
column2: Esigabeni se-MASK se-inspector: mask, bese u-'new heart'. Noma yisiphi isimo silungile. Inhliziyo iyahlekisa kakhulu.

column1: The library has circles, stars, hearts. Each one is points you can move.
column2: Ilabhulali inezindingilizi, izinkanyezi, izinhliziyo. Ngasinye singamaphoyinti ongawahambisa.

column1: A heart, Hollis? The Bureau redacts with black bars.
column2: Inhliziyo, Hollis? Ihhovisi lifihla ngemigqa emnyama.

column1: Set the tool to pen, then click round the saucer on the monitor. Click the first point to close it.
column2: Setha ithuluzi kube ipeni, bese uchofoza uzungeze isoso ku-monitor. Chofoza iphoyinti lokuqala ukuze uvale.

column1: Click for corners, drag for curves. The way the Bezier brothers intended.
column2: Chofoza amakhona, hudula amajika. Njengoba abazalwane uBézier babehlosile.

column1: Draw round it carefully. It might be watching.
Invert keeps the outside and cuts the inside. The saucer goes. The sky stays.
column2: Ukuphendula kugcina ingaphandle bese kusika ingaphakathi. Isoso iyahamba. Isibhakabhaka sisala.

column1: The same shape, the other way round. Very useful. Slightly spooky.
column2: Isimo esifanayo, ngakolunye uhlangothi. Kuyasiza kakhulu. Kuyesabisa kancane.

column1: Hollis, there's a heart-shaped hole in the sky.
column2: Hollis, kukhona imbobo emise okwenhliziyo esibhakabhakeni.

column1: Feather softens the edge, so nobody sees the cut. Press + on feather.
column2: Ukuthambisa kuthambisa umphetho, ukuze kungabikho obona ukusika. Cindezela u-+ ku-feather.

column1: A hard edge says 'someone was here'. A soft one says nothing at all.
column2: Umphetho oqinile uthi 'kukhona obekhona lapha'. Othambile awusho lutho.

column1: A library shape, the pen, invert and feather. The Bureau thanks you. The Bureau was never here.
column2: Isimo selabhulali, ipeni, ukuphendula nokuthambisa. Ihhovisi liyabonga. Ihhovisi alikaze libe lapha.

column1: Masks also go on a layer, an output, or its matte: MASK ON chooses. And every control takes a ~.
column2: Ama-mask aya nase-layer, kokuphumayo, noma ku-matte yakhona: u-MASK ON uyakhetha. Futhi zonke izilawuli zithatha u-~.

column1: The truth is in the waveform, Hollis. Next time, the scopes.
column2: Iqiniso lisesimweni segagasi, Hollis. Ngokuzayo, ama-scope.

column1: A lighthouse, a ghost, and a keeper who has been alone with the lamp far too long. Press START.
column2: Indlu yesibani, isipoki, nomgcini ohlale yedwa nesibani isikhathi eside kakhulu. Cindezela u-START.

column1: Projection mapping: bending the picture to fit the building. Warp, blend, slices.
column2: I-projection mapping: ukugoba isithombe silingane nesakhiwo. Ukusonta, ukuxuba, izingcezu.

column1: Ye'll be wanting the ghost on the windows. Mind the lamp. The lamp is MINE.
column2: Nifuna isipoki emafasiteleni, akunjalo? Qaphelani isibani. Isibani ngesaMI.

column1: MENU, then Video Outputs, then Geometry. Where an output's shape lives.
column2: I-IMENYU, bese u-Okuphumayo kwevidiyo, bese u-Ijiyomethri. Lapho kuhlala khona isimo sokuphumayo.

column1: Geometry: the projector-menu word for 'what shape is the picture'.
column2: I-jiyomethri: igama lamamenyu e-projector elisho 'isithombe simise kanjani'.

column1: Press warp edit, then drag a corner on the programme monitor. The window is not square. Neither is the keeper.
column2: Cindezela u-warp edit, bese uhudula ikhona ku-monitor yohlelo. Ifasitela aliyona isikwele. Nomgcini akayona.

column1: A corner pin moves the four corners. Perspective keeps the lines straight, like a real window.
column2: I-corner pin ihambisa amakhona amane. I-perspective igcina imigqa iqondile, njengefasitela langempela.

column1: LEFT! Ye call that a corner? I've seen straighter gulls.
column2: KWESOBUNXELE! Lokho ukubiza ngekhona? Ngike ngabona izinkwilimba eziqonde kakhudlwana.

column1: Back in Geometry: edge blend, + on the left and + on the right.
column2: Emuva ku-Ijiyomethri: edge blend, u-+ kwesobunxele no-+ kwesokudla.

column1: Two projectors overlap; each fades its edge so the overlap is not twice as bright.
column2: Ama-projector amabili ayagqagqana; ngalinye lifiphalisa umphetho walo ukuze indawo egqagqanayo ingakhanyi kabili.

column1: Geometry, SLICES, open. The Screens window is where slices are cut and placed.
column2: I-Ijiyomethri, SLICES, vula. Ifasitela le-Screens yilapho izingcezu zisikwa futhi zibekwa khona.

column1: A slice is a piece of the picture, put anywhere on the output.
column2: Ucezu luyingxenye yesithombe, ebekwe noma kuphi kokuphumayo.

column1: In the Screens window, + SLICE three times, and drag each crop to a third of the picture.
column2: Efasiteleni le-Screens, u-+ SLICE kathathu, bese uhudula ukusika ngakunye kube yingxenye yesithathu yesithombe.

column1: Three windows, three slices: left, middle and right of one picture.
column2: Amafasitela amathathu, izingcezu ezintathu: kwesobunxele, phakathi nakwesokudla kwesithombe esisodwa.

column1: Three windows. The lamp gets the middle one. The lamp ALWAYS gets the middle one.
column2: Amafasitela amathathu. Isibani sithola elisemaphakathi. Isibani SIHLALA sithola elisemaphakathi.

column1: Warp, blend, slices. The keeper will finally sleep. The gulls will not.
column2: Ukusonta, ukuxuba, izingcezu. Umgcini uzogcina elele. Izinkwilimba ngeke.

column1: Slices have their own warp and mesh in the Screens window. And a ~ on the place and the turn.
column2: Izingcezu zinokusonta kwazo kanye ne-mesh efasiteleni le-Screens. No-~ endaweni nasekujikeni.

column1: Ye did alright, lad. Now get away from the lamp.
column2: Wenze kahle, mfana. Manje suka esibanini.

column1: A game show, skapi. Three contestants, one buzzer, and cues that fire from anywhere. Press START.
column2: Umdlalo wethelevishini, skapi. Abaqhudelana abathathu, i-buzzer eyodwa, nama-cue aqhuma noma kuphi. Cindezela u-START.

column1: Cue numbers, hotkeys, and GO from other machines. Like a sequencer you can play from any key.
column2: Izinombolo ze-cue, izinkinobho ezisheshayo, no-GO osuka kweminye imishini. Njenge-sequencer oyidlala nganoma iyiphi inkinobho.

column1: Welcome to the show! Let's spin that wheel!
Contestant 3 is selected. In the inspector's metadata, give it a cue number: 3.
column2: Umqhudelani 3 ukhethiwe. Kumethadatha ye-inspector, yinike inombolo ye-cue: 3.

column1: Theatre numbers its cues. Q3, Q3.5, Q12A. Deckboy reads them all.
column2: Ithiyetha ibeka izinombolo kuma-cue ayo. Q3, Q3.5, Q12A. UDeckboy uyazifunda zonke.

column1: I'd like to buy a number, please.
Ctrl+G, type the number, Enter. It goes live wherever the list happens to be standing.
column2: Ctrl+G, bhala inombolo, Enter. Iya emoyeni, noma uhlu lume kuphi.

column1: GOTO. The fastest way across a long list. Faster than scrolling. Much faster than me.
column2: U-GOTO. Indlela esheshayo ohlwini olude. Ishesha kunokuskrola. Ishesha kakhulu kunami.

column1: Contestant 1 is selected. In TRIGGERS, press key, then F5. That key now fires this cue.
column2: Umqhudelani 1 ukhethiwe. Ku-TRIGGERS, cindezela u-key, bese u-F5. Leyo nkinobho manje iqhumisa le cue.

column1: F1 to F10, F12, or the number pad. Each one, a buzzer.
column2: F1 kuya ku-F10, F12, noma i-number pad. Ngayinye, i-buzzer.

column1: Press the key. The cue fires, wherever the list is standing.
column2: Cindezela inkinobho. I-cue iyaqhuma, noma uhlu lume kuphi.

column1: No mouse, no list, no looking. Just the key.
column2: Akukho mouse, akukho hlu, akukho ukubheka. Inkinobho nje.

column1: Companion, a MIDI note, an OSC message: MENU, then Network, says where each one connects.
column2: U-Companion, inothi ye-MIDI, umlayezo we-OSC: i-IMENYU, bese u-Inethiwekhi, kusho ukuthi ngayinye ixhuma kuphi.

column1: A Stream Deck in the next room can press GO. So can a keyboard synth. I prefer the synth.
column2: I-Stream Deck egumbini elilandelayo ingacindezela u-GO. Ne-keyboard synth futhi. Mina ngithanda i-synth.

column1: And for our viewers at home: you can play along too.
column2: Futhi ababukeli abasekhaya: nani ningadlala nathi.

column1: Numbers, GOTO, a buzzer, and GO from anywhere. You are a game show now, skapi.
column2: Izinombolo, u-GOTO, i-buzzer, no-GO osuka noma kuphi. Manje usungumdlalo wethelevishini, skapi.

column1: A cue can have a key, a MIDI note and an OSC address at once. Belt, braces and a second belt.
column2: I-cue ingaba nenkinobho, inothi ye-MIDI nekheli le-OSC ngesikhathi esisodwa. Ibhande, ama-brace nebhande lesibili.

column1: Channel 6 weather, skapi. A map, a presenter, and a very large lizard. Press START.
column2: Isimo sezulu ku-Channel 6, skapi. Imephu, umethuli, nesibankwa esikhulu kakhulu. Kukhulu kunesiphepho saseHighveld. Cindezela u-START.

column1: Words on screen: Lower Thirds, text, and backdrops.
column2: Amagama esikrinini: ama-lower third, umbhalo, nezingemuva.

column1: I'm June O'Neil, and nothing about this forecast is normal.
column2: NginguJune O'Neil, futhi akukho lutho olujwayelekile kulesi sibikezelo.

column1: Words go on their own layer: press the + at the end of the playlist tabs.
column2: Amagama aya ku-layer yawo: cindezela u-+ ekugcineni kwamathebhu e-playlist.

column1: A second playlist is a layer over the map. The lizard stays underneath. Mostly.
column2: I-playlist yesibili iyi-layer phezu kwemephu. Isibankwa sihlala ngaphansi. Ngokuvamile.

column1: Words on top. Always on top.
In the new playlist: SOURCE, then Lower Third.
column2: Ku-playlist entsha: u-UMTHOMBO, bese u-Lower Third.

column1: A name and a title, low on the screen, out of the lizard's way.
column2: Igama nesikhundla, phansi esikrinini, kude nendlela yesibankwa.

column1: In the inspector, title: type the presenter's name. The second line is her job.
column2: Ku-inspector, title: bhala igama lomethuli. Umugqa wesibili ngumsebenzi wakhe.

column1: Spelling counts. The audience reads it at the speed of light.
column2: Ukupela kubalulekile. Izethameli zifunda ngejubane lokukhanya.

column1: Spell it right. Last week it said 'Jane O'Meal'.
column2: Lipele kahle. Ngesonto eledlule kwakubhalwe 'June O'Ndlovu'.

column1: TAKE the Lower Third. Her name slides in over the map.
column2: U-TAKE i-lower third. Igama lakhe lishelela phezu kwemephu.

column1: Two layers live: the weather, and the words on top of it.
column2: Ama-layer amabili emoyeni: isimo sezulu, namagama phezu kwaso.

column1: Thank you. Now, about that lizard...
SOURCE, then Text: a title card. Then its backdrop chip: key green, for the vision mixer to key out.
column2: U-UMTHOMBO, bese u-Text: ikhadi lesihloko. Bese isigcawu sengemuva: okuluhlaza kwe-key, ukuze i-vision mixer ikukhiphe.

column1: A backdrop fills behind the words. Key green or key blue, and the mixer does the rest.
column2: Ingemuva ligcwalisa ngemuva kwamagama. Okuluhlaza noma okuluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka kwe-key, i-mixer yenza okunye.

column1: Breaking news: it's standing on the five-day forecast.
column2: Izindaba ezishisayo: simi phezu kwesibikezelo sezinsuku ezinhlanu.

column1: A Lower Third, a name, a title card, a backdrop. The lizard has left the studio, skapi.
column2: I-lower third, igama, ikhadi lesihloko, ingemuva. Isibankwa siphume esitudiyo, skapi.

column1: Lower Thirds can wait, slide and leave on their own. Their section has every setting.
column2: Ama-lower third angalinda, ashelele futhi aphume ngokwawo. Isigaba sawo sinazo zonke izilungiselelo.

column1: That's the weather. Back to you, guys. Run.
column2: Lesi bekuyisimo sezulu. Sibuyela esitudiyo. Gijimani.

column1: A rocket built in a basement, skapi, and an inventor who wants cheese. Press START.
column2: Irokhethi elakhiwe egumbini elingaphansi, skapi, nomsunguli ofuna ushizi. Cindezela u-START.

column1: Stage timers: countdowns, clocks, and a presenter view for the person on stage.
column2: Izikhathi zesiteji: ukubala phansi, amawashi, nombono womethuli womuntu osesiteji.

column1: Cheese, Grommet! The moon's made of it. We'll need a countdown.
column2: Ushizi, Grommet! Inyanga yenziwe ngawo. Sizodinga ukubala phansi.

column1: SOURCE, then Stage Timer. A clock that counts down, in big friendly numbers.
column2: U-UMTHOMBO, bese u-Stage Timer. Iwashi elibalela emuva, ngezinombolo ezinkulu ezinobungane.

column1: Its colours change as it runs out: white, amber, red. Like a VU meter for time.
column2: Imibala yalo iyashintsha njengoba isikhathi siphela: okumhlophe, okumpofu, okubomvu. Njenge-VU meter yesikhathi.

column1: Select the timer and TAKE it. The countdown starts.
column2: Khetha isikhathi wenze u-TAKE. Ukubala kuyaqala.

column1: Past zero it keeps going, counting the overtime. Very honest. Slightly rude.
column2: Ngemuva kuka-zero luyaqhubeka, lubala isikhathi esengeziwe. Kuthembekile kakhulu. Kunenhlamba kancane.

column1: Ten... nine... ooh, I do love a countdown.
column2: Ishumi... ayisishiyagalolunye... hawu, ngiyakuthanda ukubala phansi.

column1: Something's loose! Space holds the countdown. The clock shows it is held.
column2: Kukhona okuxegayo! I-space imisa ukubala. Iwashi libonisa ukuthi limisiwe.

column1: A hold is not a stop. Space again, and it carries on from where it was.
column2: Ukumisa akusikho ukuyeka. I-space futhi, luqhubeke lapho belukhona.

column1: MENU, Video Outputs: make an output's type PRESENTER. The person on stage gets the timer, the next cue and their notes.
column2: I-IMENYU, Okuphumayo kwevidiyo: yenza uhlobo lokuphumayo lube ngu-PRESENTER. Umuntu osesiteji uthola isikhathi, i-cue elandelayo namanothi akhe.

column1: A presenter view is an output like any other. Point it at the confidence monitor.
column2: Umbono womethuli ungokuphumayo njengakho konke okunye. Wukhombise ku-monitor yesiteji.

column1: So the pilot can see the time. The pilot is Grommet.
column2: Ukuze umshayeli abone isikhathi. Umshayeli nguGrommet.

column1: A countdown, a hold, and a view for the pilot. Nazdrave, skapi. Bring crackers.
column2: Ukubala phansi, ukumisa, nombono womshayeli. Nazdrave, skapi. Letha amabhisikidi.

column1: Timers can also count up, or show the time of day. Their section has the lot.
column2: Izikhathi zingabala futhi phezulu, noma zibonise isikhathi sosuku. Isigaba sazo sinakho konke.

column1: A grand day out, Grommet! Pass the crackers.
A magic show, skapi. A trunk, a prop, and one beat where everything changes at once. Press START.
column2: Umbukiso womlingo, skapi. Isifuba, into yokudlala, nesigqi esisodwa lapho konke kushintsha ngasikhathi sinye. Cindezela u-START.

column1: Two playlists are two layers. TAKE ALL changes both together.
column2: Ama-playlist amabili angama-layer amabili. U-TAKE ALL uwashintsha womabili ndawonye.

column1: Every trick needs two things happening at once. And a rubber chicken.
column2: Lonke iqhinga lidinga izinto ezimbili ezenzeka ngasikhathi sinye. Nenkukhu yerabha.

column1: The prop goes on its own layer. Press the + at the end of the playlist tabs.
column2: Into yokudlala iya ku-layer yayo. Cindezela u-+ ekugcineni kwamathebhu e-playlist.

column1: Playlist 2 sits on top of playlist 1. Like a transparency on an overhead projector.
column2: I-playlist 2 ihlala phezu kwe-playlist 1. Njenge-transparency ku-overhead projector.

column1: Nothing up my sleeve. Everything in my trunk.
column2: Akukho lutho emkhonweni wami. Konke kusesifubeni sami.

column1: In the new playlist, add anything: PATTERN will do. That is the prop.
column2: Ku-playlist entsha, engeza noma yini: u-IPHETHINI uzokwenza. Leyo yinto yokudlala.

column1: Whatever it is, it will appear the instant the trunk opens.
column2: Noma kuyini, kuzovela ngomzuzu isifuba sivuleka ngawo.

column1: Is it a rubber chicken? It's always a rubber chicken.
Select 'The trunk (open)' in playlist 1 and the prop in playlist 2. Then TAKE ALL: both on one beat.
column2: Khetha 'Isifuba (sivuliwe)' ku-playlist 1 nento yokudlala ku-playlist 2. Bese u-TAKE ALL: kokubili ngesigqi esisodwa.

column1: One press, every playlist's selected cue. The audience never sees the seam.
column2: Ukucindezela okukodwa, i-cue ekhethiwe ye-playlist ngayinye. Izethameli azisoze zabona umthungo.

column1: Two layers, one beat. Every playlist has its own opacity and can sit on any output. Nazdrave, skapi.
column2: Ama-layer amabili, isigqi esisodwa. Yonke i-playlist ine-opacity yayo futhi ingahlala kunoma yikuphi okuphumayo. Nazdrave, skapi.

column1: A magician never reveals. A playlist never minds being revealed.
column2: Umlingo akaveli ngemfihlo. I-playlist ayinandaba uma idaluliwe.

column1: Thank you! I'm here all week! The chicken is here forever.
column2: Ngiyabonga! Ngilapha isonto lonke! Inkukhu ilapha unomphela.

column1: A cooking show, skapi. Live. Everything is on fire. Press START.
column2: Umbukiso wokupheka, skapi. Bukhoma. Konke kuyasha. Cindezela u-START.

column1: BLACK hides the picture and keeps the show running. PANIC stops everything. Know which you need.
column2: U-BLACK ufihla isithombe agcine umbukiso uqhubeka. U-PANIC umisa konke. Yazi ukuthi yikuphi okudingayo.

column1: Bork bork! Hurdy-flurdy, de kitchen is fire-a-flurdy!
The audience must not see this. Press BLACK, or B.
column2: Izethameli akumele zibone lokhu. Cindezela u-BLACK, noma u-B.

column1: The picture goes. The cue keeps playing underneath, ready to come back.
column2: Isithombe siyahamba. I-cue iqhubeka idlala ngaphansi, ilungele ukubuya.

column1: Bork? Bork. Oh, de picture is gun.
The fire's out. Press B again: the picture comes back, still running.
column2: Umlilo ucimile. Cindezela u-B futhi: isithombe siyabuya, sisasebenza.

column1: Nothing was lost. A mute on a mixer, for pictures.
Worse: MENU, System, the SAFETY card: PANIC. Everything stops, the way the panic setting says.
column2: Kubi kakhulu: i-IMENYU, Isistimu, ikhadi le-SAFETY: u-PANIC. Konke kuyama, njengoba isilungiselelo sokwethuka sisho.

column1: PANIC is the big red button. Use it when BLACK is not enough. Then breathe.
column2: U-PANIC yinkinobho enkulu ebomvu. Yisebenzise uma u-BLACK enganele. Bese uphefumula.

column1: Close MENU, select the souffle, and TAKE it. The show is back on.
column2: Vala i-IMENYU, khetha i-soufflé, wenze u-TAKE. Umbukiso uyaqhubeka futhi.

column1: After a panic, the show is still there. Pick up where you meant to be.
column2: Ngemuva kokwethuka, umbukiso usekhona. Qhubeka lapho ubufuna ukuba khona.

column1: Voila! De souffle, he is risen!
BLACK to hide, PANIC to stop, TAKE to come back. You will survive any kitchen, skapi.
column2: U-BLACK ukufihla, u-PANIC ukumisa, u-TAKE ukubuya. Uzosinda kunoma yiliphi ikhishi, skapi.

column1: The panic setting chooses what PANIC does: fade out, cut, or just the outputs.
column2: Isilungiselelo sokwethuka sikhetha ukuthi u-PANIC wenzani: ukufiphala, ukusika, noma okuphumayo kuphela.

column1: Presets, skapi. A whole look, remembered, and back with one button. Press START.
column2: Ama-preset, skapi. Ukubukeka konke, kukhunjulwe, futhi kubuye ngenkinobho eyodwa. Cindezela u-START.

column1: Like the patch memory on a synth: store, then recall.
column2: Njengememori ye-patch ku-synth: gcina, bese ubiza.

column1: Press DASH: buttons of your own, for anything at all.
column2: Cindezela u-DASH: izinkinobho zakho, zanoma yini.

column1: Ctrl+D also works. Very fast. Very professional.
column2: I-Ctrl+D nayo iyasebenza. Kuyashesha kakhulu. Kuchwepheshile kakhulu.

column1: Press +, then 'preset - a new preset from what is on now'. The button remembers this look.
column2: Cindezela u-+, bese u-'preset - a new preset from what is on now'. Inkinobho iyakhumbula lokhu kubukeka.

column1: Store. Like saving the patch before the drummer leans on the synth.
column2: Gcina. Njengokulondoloza i-patch ngaphambi kokuthi umshayi wezigubhu ancike ku-synth.

column1: Close the DASH (Esc), then select Look two and TAKE it. A different look.
column2: Vala i-DASH (Esc), bese ukhetha Ukubukeka kwesibili wenze u-TAKE. Ukubukeka okuhlukile.

column1: Change it all. Don't worry. It remembers.
Open the DASH and press your preset button. The first look comes back.
column2: Vula i-DASH ucindezele inkinobho yakho ye-preset. Ukubukeka kokuqala kuyabuya.

column1: Recall. The patch memory, returning. Beautiful.
A look, stored and recalled. A preset can keep cues, positions, effects, levels and routing; its button's menu chooses which.
column2: Ukubukeka, kugcinwe futhi kubiziwe. I-preset ingagcina ama-cue, izindawo, imiphumela, amazinga ne-routing; imenyu yenkinobho yayo ikhetha ukuthi yikuphi.

column1: And a DASH button can run any command at all. Any. Even the exciting ones.
column2: Futhi inkinobho ye-DASH ingaqhuba noma yimuphi umyalo. Noma yimuphi. Ngisho nalabo abajabulisayo.

column1: A space-opera trailer, skapi. A narrator with a very deep voice and opinions about transitions. Press START.
column2: I-trailer ye-space opera, skapi. Umxoxi onezwi elijulile kakhulu nemibono ngokuguqula. Cindezela u-START.

column1: A transition is how one cue becomes the next. There are far more than the crossfade.
column2: Ukuguqula yindlela i-cue eyodwa eba ngayo elandelayo. Kunezingaphezu kwe-crossfade.

column1: In a galaxy of content... one operator... must choose a transition.
column2: Emthaleni wokuqukethwe... umsebenzisi oyedwa... kumele akhethe ukuguqula.

column1: 'The planet' is selected. In the inspector, its transition style: choose iris.
column2: 'Iplanethi' ikhethiwe. Ku-inspector, isitayela sayo sokuguqula: khetha iris.

column1: Pushes, wipes, iris, dip to white. Even a portal. I wrote half of them. On a Tuesday.
column2: Ukusunduza, ukusula, i-iris, ukucwila kokumhlophe. Ngisho nesango. Ingxenye ngayibhala mina. NgoLwesibili.

column1: The planet deserves... a dramatic entrance.
Give it a time: + on transition until it says a second or more.
column2: Yinike isikhathi: u-+ ku-ukuguqula kuze kube kusho umzuzwana noma ngaphezulu.

column1: No time, no transition. A style needs a duration to do anything at all.
column2: Asikho isikhathi, akukho kuguqula. Isitayela sidinga ubude ukuze senze noma yini.

column1: TAKE the planet. Watch it arrive.
The transition belongs to the cue arriving. Each cue chooses its own entrance.
column2: Ukuguqula kungokwe-cue efikayo. I-cue ngayinye ikhetha ukungena kwayo.

column1: Now 'The battle': choose shatter, give it a time, and TAKE it.
column2: Manje 'Impi': khetha i-shatter, uyinike isikhathi, wenze u-TAKE.

column1: Shatter drops the old picture like a pane of glass. Please do not do this at a funeral.
column2: I-shatter iwisa isithombe esidala njengengilazi. Ngicela ningakwenzi lokhu emngcwabeni.

column1: A style, a time, and two very dramatic entrances. Nazdrave, skapi.
column2: Isitayela, isikhathi, nokungena okubili okumangalisa kakhulu. Nazdrave, skapi.

column1: A playlist has a default style too, for every cue that does not choose its own.
column2: I-playlist nayo inesitayela esizenzakalelayo, sayo yonke i-cue engazikhetheli esayo.

column1: Coming soon... to a desk near you.
Two robot DJs, skapi. They do not talk. Their helmets do. Press START.
column2: Ama-DJ amarobhothi amabili, skapi. Awakhulumi. Kukhuluma izigqoko zawo. Cindezela u-START.

column1: Every cue has its own chain of audio effects, and some of them break the sound on purpose.
column2: Yonke i-cue inochungechunge lwayo lwemiphumela yomsindo, futhi eminye iphula umsindo ngamabomu.

column1: > HELLO. WE ARE HERE TO FIX YOUR MIX.
The beat is selected. In its AUDIO EFFECTS section, + adds one. Try the delay.
column2: Isigqi sikhethiwe. Esigabeni sayo se-AUDIO EFFECTS, u-+ wengeza owodwa. Zama i-delay.

column1: Delay, reverb, filters, a compressor. Amount always means 'less of this'.
column2: I-delay, i-reverb, izihlungi, i-compressor. Inani lihlala lisho 'okuncane kwalokhu'.

column1: > ONE MORE TIME. WITH ECHO. ECHO. ECHO.
Add a second: a bend, like crush. It damages the sound the way a broken file would.
column2: Engeza owesibili: ukugoba, njenge-crush. Kulimaza umsindo njengefayela eliphukile.

column1: The bends are my favourite. Like a tape left in the sun. On purpose.
column2: Ukugoba yikho engikuthanda kakhulu. Njengekhasethi elishiywe elangeni. Ngamabomu.

column1: MENU, then Audio: where each playlist's sound goes, and the patch for named outputs.
column2: I-IMENYU, bese u-Umsindo: lapho umsindo we-playlist ngayinye uya khona, ne-patch yokuphumayo okunamagama.

column1: Speakers, monitors, an in-ear for the drummer. The patch sends each its own.
column2: Izipikha, ama-monitor, i-in-ear yomshayi wezigubhu. I-patch ithumela ngamunye okwakhe.

column1: > AROUND THE MIX. AROUND THE MIX. AROUND THE MIX.
column2: > EZUNGEZE I-MIX. EZUNGEZE I-MIX. EZUNGEZE I-MIX.

column1: An effect, a bend and the patch. The robots approve, skapi. I think. Their faces are helmets.
column2: Umphumela, ukugoba ne-patch. Amarobhothi ayavuma, skapi. Ngicabanga. Ubuso bawo yizigqoko.

column1: Every audio effect can follow a ~ too, even Motion. Wave at the delay. It's wonderful.
column2: Yonke imiphumela yomsindo ingalandela u-~ futhi, ngisho no-Motion. Phakamisela i-delay isandla. Kuyamangalisa.

column1: > THANK YOU. GOOD NIGHT. WE ARE ROBOTS.
The Bureau again, skapi. A glow on the horizon, and two agents who disagree about it. Press START.
column2: Ihhovisi futhi, skapi. Ukukhanya emkhathizwe, nama-ejenti amabili angavumelani ngakho. Cindezela u-START.

column1: The scopes measure a picture: brightness, colour, levels. Numbers, not opinions.
column2: Ama-scope alinganisa isithombe: ukukhanya, umbala, amazinga. Izinombolo, hhayi imibono.

column1: It's them, Brandt. It's a craft. Look how it glows.
column2: Yibo, Brandt. Ngumkhumbi. Bheka ukuthi ukhanya kanjani.

column1: The scopes read only what really goes out, never a preview. Turn the output on: MENU, Video Outputs, OUTPUT OFF.
column2: Ama-scope afunda kuphela okuphuma ngempela, hhayi i-preview. Vula okuphumayo: i-IMENYU, Okuphumayo kwevidiyo, OKUPHUMAYO KUVALIWE.

column1: Measuring a scaled-down preview would be measuring a photocopy. We measure the original.
column2: Ukulinganisa i-preview encishisiwe kungaba njengokulinganisa i-photocopy. Thina silinganisa okwangempela.

column1: Chain of evidence, Hollis. The real signal or nothing.
column2: Uchungechunge lobufakazi, Hollis. Isignali yangempela noma lutho.

column1: Close MENU. Above the monitor, the PROGRAM button: press it until it says SCOPES or BOTH.
column2: Vala i-IMENYU. Ngaphezu kwe-monitor, inkinobho ye-PROGRAM: yicindezele kuze kube kuthi SCOPES noma BOTH.

column1: Both shows the picture and its scopes side by side. Very civilised.
column2: U-BOTH ubonisa isithombe nama-scope aso eceleni. Kunesizotha kakhulu.

column1: Click the waveform to make it big. Bright things sit high, dark things low, left to right as in the picture.
column2: Chofoza i-waveform ukuze ibe nkulu. Izinto ezikhanyayo zihlala phezulu, ezimnyama phansi, kusuka kwesobunxele kuya kwesokudla njengasesithombeni.

column1: The glow is that spike near the top. Very bright. Bright is not the same as alien.
column2: Ukukhanya yileyo nsonga eduze kwaphezulu. Kukhanya kakhulu. Ukukhanya akufani nokuba ngowasemkhathini.

column1: Look at the peak. Nothing a streetlight couldn't do.
column2: Bheka inqanaba. Akukho lutho isibani somgwaqo esingeke sikwenze.

column1: Click it again to go back, then click the vectorscope: colour round a circle. Saturated runs to the edge.
column2: Chofoza futhi ubuyele emuva, bese uchofoza i-vectorscope: umbala uzungeza indilinga. Okugcwele kugijimela emaphethelweni.

column1: Magenta, far out by the rim. A strong colour. Strong is not illegal. Yet.
column2: I-magenta, kude emaphethelweni. Umbala oqinile. Oqinile akusikho okungekho emthethweni. Okwamanje.

column1: It's off the chart, Brandt! Literally off the chart!
And false colour: red is clipped, yellow nearly. Is the glow red?
column2: Nombala ongamanga: okubomvu kusikiwe, okuphuzi cishe. Ingabe ukukhanya kubomvu?

column1: Clipped means the brightest the signal can carry, and then some lost. Detail gone.
column2: Okusikiwe kusho okukhanya kakhulu isignali engakuthwala, nokunye ngaphezulu kulahlekile. Imininingwane ihambile.

column1: Red. Clipped. Not alien, Hollis. Just too bright. Case closed.
column2: Okubomvu. Kusikiwe. Akusiwo owasemkhathini, Hollis. Kukhanya kakhulu nje. Icala livaliwe.

column1: Waveform, vectorscope, false colour. The scopes settled it, skapi. The agents did not.
column2: I-waveform, i-vectorscope, umbala ongamanga. Ama-scope akuxazulule, skapi. Ama-ejenti awakuxazululanga.

column1: SCOPES SOURCE reads any output, and the matrix can be 709 or 2020. For the curious.
column2: U-SCOPES SOURCE ufunda noma yikuphi okuphumayo, futhi i-matrix ingaba ngu-709 noma 2020. Kwabanelukuluku.

column1: Too bright for a streetlight, Brandt. Too bright for anything. ...I want to believe.
column2: Kukhanya kakhulu kwesibani somgwaqo, Brandt. Kukhanya kakhulu kunoma yini. ...Ngifuna ukukholwa.

column1: Pictures that leave by cable or network, skapi, not only a window on a screen. Press START.
column2: Izithombe eziphuma ngekhebula noma ngenethiwekhi, skapi, hhayi nje ifasitela esikrinini. Cindezela u-START.

column1: NDI over the network, SDI from a DeckLink card, ST 2110 for broadcast plants.
column2: U-NDI ngenethiwekhi, u-SDI ovela kukhadi le-DeckLink, u-ST 2110 wezindawo zokusakaza.

column1: MENU, Video Outputs, then Devices: every way an output can leave this computer.
column2: I-IMENYU, Okuphumayo kwevidiyo, bese u-Amadivayisi: zonke izindlela okuphumayo okungashiya ngazo le khompyutha.

column1: Each one says whether this machine can do it, and what it needs if not.
column2: Ngayinye isho ukuthi lo mshini ungakwenza yini, nokuthi udingani uma ungakwazi.

column1: If this computer has NDI, switch NDI SENDING on: the picture is on the network. If not, SHOW ME moves on.
column2: Uma le khompyutha ino-NDI, vula u-NDI SENDING: isithombe sisenethiwekhini. Uma kungenjalo, u-SHOW ME uyaqhubeka.

column1: NDI finds itself on the network. No cables, only a good switch and patience.
column2: U-NDI uzithola yena kunethiwekhi. Awekho amakhebula, i-switch enhle nokubekezela kuphela.

column1: The output's own page has the rest: a DeckLink card's SDI, ST 2110 with NMOS, Spout and Syphon.
column2: Ikhasi lokuphumayo uqobo linokunye: u-SDI wekhadi le-DeckLink, u-ST 2110 no-NMOS, u-Spout no-Syphon.

column1: Every one is just an output. The show does not know or care how it leaves.
column2: Ngayinye ingokuphumayo nje. Umbukiso awazi futhi awunandaba ukuthi uphuma kanjani.

column1: The bridge of the starship Cathode, skapi. Four feeds, one main viewer, one mystery. Press START.
column2: Ibhuloho lomkhumbi-mkhathi i-Cathode, skapi. Ama-feed amane, isikrini esikhulu esisodwa, imfihlakalo eyodwa. Cindezela u-START.

column1: The multiview shows every playlist at once. Like a wall of oscilloscopes, but in space.
column2: I-multiview ibonisa wonke ama-playlist ngasikhathi sinye. Njengodonga lwama-oscilloscope, kodwa emkhathini.

column1: Frequencies open, Captain. All of them. That's the problem.
column2: Ama-frequency avuliwe, Kaputeni. Wonke. Yinkinga leyo.

column1: MULTI, above the monitor: every playlist in its own window.
column2: U-MULTI, ngaphezu kwe-monitor: i-playlist ngayinye efasiteleni layo.

column1: One window per playlist, the programme first.
Jinkys! Four feeds. And one of them has a monster in it.
column2: Jinkys! Ama-feed amane. Futhi kwelinye linesilo.

column1: Add a window (+), then its ... menu: make it show NEXT. What goes live when you press TAKE.
column2: Engeza ifasitela (+), bese imenyu yalo ethi ...: yenza libonise u-NEXT. Okuya emoyeni uma ucindezela u-TAKE.

column1: Every window has a ... button. It chooses what that window shows.
column2: Wonke amafasitela anenkinobho ethi .... Ikhetha ukuthi lelo fasitela libonisani.

column1: I need to see who's calling before they reach the main viewer.
column2: Ngidinga ukubona ukuthi ngubani ofonayo ngaphambi kokuthi afike esikrinini esikhulu.

column1: And one more window, showing the clock. Operators who watch a clock are never late. Mostly.
column2: Nelinye ifasitela, elibonisa iwashi. Abasebenzisi ababheka iwashi abaze bephuze. Ngokuvamile.

column1: Time of day, big. Stardates are just very long timecode.
column2: Isikhathi sosuku, sikhulu. Ama-stardate ayi-timecode ende kakhulu nje.

column1: The monster only shows up at midnight. We're going to need a clock.
column2: Isilo sivela phakathi kwamabili kuphela. Sizodinga iwashi.

column1: Any window's ... menu, then a layout: one big, the rest small.
column2: Imenyu ethi ... yanoma yiliphi ifasitela, bese ukuhleleka: elilodwa elikhulu, amanye amancane.

column1: The big window is window one. Usually the programme. Usually.
column2: Ifasitela elikhulu yifasitela lokuqala. Ngokuvamile uhlelo. Ngokuvamile.

column1: Main viewer big. The captain likes it big.
column2: Isikrini esikhulu sibe sikhulu. UKaputeni usithanda sikhulu.

column1: Select Deck 3 in playlist 3 and TAKE. Watch its window.
column2: Khetha Idekhi 3 ku-playlist 3 wenze u-TAKE. Buka ifasitela layo.

column1: The red border is TALLY: the window that is on air. On screen, as they say on starships.
column2: Uhlaka olubomvu ngu-TALLY: ifasitela elisemoyeni. Esikrinini, njengoba besho emikhunjini-mkhathi.

column1: There! Feed three! Put it on screen!
Windows, the ... menu, NEXT, the clock, a layout, tally. Mystery solved, skapi.
column2: Amafasitela, imenyu ethi ..., u-NEXT, iwashi, ukuhleleka, i-tally. Imfihlakalo ixazululiwe, skapi.

column1: A window can also show an output, with its warp and slices. Handy when it's a lighthouse.
column2: Ifasitela lingabonisa nokuphumayo, nokusonta kwakho nezingcezu. Kuyasiza uma kuyindlu yesibani.

column1: And the monster was... the ship's cook, all along. Jinkys.
column2: Futhi isilo bekungu... umpheki womkhumbi, sonke isikhathi. Jinkys.

column1: finish or leave the lesson you are in first
column2: qeda noma uphume esifundweni okuso kuqala

column1: Psst. It's me, the desk. I'll be watching. Supportively.
Hi! I'm the one doing all of this, by the way.
column2: Sawubona! Yimi owenza konke lokhu, phela.

column1: Ctrl+D opens the DASH. I'm just saying.
Nearly there. I can feel it in my pixels.
You're good at this. I can tell. I'm the one doing it.
Every click, I heard. Every single one.
The glowing one. I can see it from here. It's glowing for you.
lesson paused - MENU > LESSONS picks up where you left off
column2: isifundo simisiwe - i-IMENYU > LESSONS iqhubeka lapho ugcine khona

column1: PROF. VIDEO:  The signal: what the picture is made of, and how to bend it. Pick a lesson.
column2: PROF. VIDEO:  Isignali: isithombe senziwe ngani, nokuthi usigoba kanjani. Khetha isifundo.

column1: DR. PIXEL:  Running the show, skapi. Fast hands, calm face. Pick a lesson.

column1: Stop that deck when the ramp lands - the usual take-it-down-and-stop-it
column2: Misa leyo deck uma i-ramp ifika - okujwayelekile ukwehlisa nokumisa

column1: Which of the file's sound tracks plays: a second language, a commentary
column2: Iyiphi ingoma yomsindo efayeleni edlalayo: ulimi lwesibili, incazelo

column1: An oscillator on the colour: depth is how far round the wheel it travels
column2: I-oscillator embaleni: ukujula kuyibanga elizungeza isondo

column1: Rack this cue paused and off air so GO starts it with no decoder spin-up
column2: Lungiselela le cue imisiwe ingekho emoyeni ukuze i-GO iyiqale ngaphandle kokulinda i-decoder

column1: Note, control change, program change, MIDI Show Control, or your own bytes
column2: Inothi, control change, program change, MIDI Show Control, noma ama-byte akho

column1: Black behind the words. Zero leaves it over whatever the output already has
column2: Okumnyama ngemuva kwamagama. U-zero uwashiya phezu kwalokho okuphumayo okunakho

column1: How far the modulator bends the pitch. 0-63, the hardware's own gain range.
column2: I-modulator igoba iphimbo kangakanani. 0-63, ububanzi benzuzo yehadiwe uqobo.

column1: the words this cue puts on screen  |  Shift+Enter: new line  |  Enter: apply
column2: amagama le cue ewabeka esikrinini  |  Shift+Enter: umugqa omusha  |  Enter: faka

column1: OSC and UDP are fire and forget; TCP connects, so it runs off the show thread
column2: I-OSC ne-UDP ziyathumela bese zikhohlwa; i-TCP iyaxhuma, ngakho isebenza ngaphandle kochungechunge lombukiso

column1: Put the level on an oscillator: Motion makes it a gate that opens as you move
column2: Beka izinga ku-oscillator: i-Motion ilenza isango elivuleka uma unyakaza

column1: Marks stacked ABOVE the characters, the way combining accents overflow a line.
column2: Izimpawu zinqwabelene NGENHLA kwezinhlamvu, njengezimpawu ezidlula umugqa.

column1: Save the mask as a greyscale PNG at the output's size: white keeps, black cuts
column2: Gcina imaski njenge-PNG empunga ngosayizi wokuphumayo: okumhlophe kuyagcina, okumnyama kuyasika

column1: Which chime. Cycling PLAYS it, so it can be chosen by ear rather than by name.
column2: Iyiphi insimbi. Ukushintsha kuyayidlala, ukuze ikhethwe ngendlebe hhayi ngegama.

column1: No rows. + ADD or LEARN makes one; MIDIMAP RESET brings the built-in rows back.
column2: Ayikho imigqa. + ADD noma LEARN yenza owodwa; MIDIMAP RESET ibuyisa imigqa yokuqala.

column1: Save the mask's paths as SVG, for Illustrator and anything else that reads them
column2: Gcina izindlela zemaski njenge-SVG, ze-Illustrator nanoma yini ezifundayo

column1: Which MIDI output; a named port that is missing is reported rather than swapped
column2: Isiphi i-MIDI ephumayo; iphothi eqanjiwe engekho iyabikwa, ayishintshwa

column1: An oscillator on the level, running after GO until a later cue sets this fixture
column2: I-oscillator ezingeni, isebenza ngemuva kwe-GO kuze kube i-cue elandelayo isetha lesi sibani

column1: Steps in third-octaves, because the ear works in ratios. 1kHz is the convention.
column2: Izinyathelo ezingxenyeni zesithathu ze-octave, ngoba indlebe isebenza ngezilinganiso. U-1kHz uyinkambiso.

column1: Strikes drawn ACROSS the cell, damaging the character rather than decorating it.
column2: Imivimbo edwetshwe NGAPHESHEYA kweseli, ilimaza uhlamvu esikhundleni sokuluhlobisa.

column1: Whether incoming MIDI notes play this synth or trigger cues as they always have.
column2: Ukuthi amanothi e-MIDI angenayo adlala le synth noma aqala ama-cue njengakuqala.

column1: A note number, or type LEARN and play it. Notes no cue claims still go to cue N+1
column2: Inombolo yenothi, noma thayipha LEARN bese uyidlala. Amanothi angenayo i-cue ayaya ku-cue N+1

column1: A plain stereo pair. Click to open the matrix, starting from exactly this routing
column2: Ipheya ye-stereo elula. Chofoza ukuvula i-matrix, kusukela kulo mzila ngqo

column1: Folding is what turns an arbitrary pattern into something that reads as designed.
column2: Ukugoqa yikho okwenza iphethini engahleliwe ibukeke idizayiniwe.

column1: Channel=level, comma separated. Ranges too: 1=255, 10-14=64. Channels count from 1
column2: Isiteshi=izinga, kuhlukaniswe ngokhefana. Namabanga: 1=255, 10-14=64. Iziteshi zibalwa kusukela ku-1

column1: Moves every selected cue's trim by the same dB; typing a value sets them all to it
column2: Ihambisa i-trim yayo yonke i-cue ekhethiwe nge-dB efanayo; ukuthayipha inani kuzisetha zonke kulo

column1: Bends the carrier's PITCH rather than mixing with it. This is what makes FDS growl.
column2: Igoba IPHIMBO le-carrier esikhundleni sokuxuba nalo. Yilokhu okwenza i-FDS ibhonge.

column1: Half way through LEARN THE BASICS. Press L and we pick up where you stopped, skapi.
column2: Uphakathi nendawo ku-UKUFUNDA OKUYISISEKELO. Cindezela u-L siqhubeke lapho ume khona, skapi.

column1: Render as a character grid with a 16-colour indexed palette, rather than as pixels.
column2: Dweba njengegridi yezinhlamvu enephalethi enemibala engu-16, hhayi njengamaphikseli.

column1: Which MIDI output this file plays to; step past the end for the first one available
column2: Iyiphi i-MIDI ephumayo le fayela elidlalela kuyo; dlula ekugcineni kwetholakalayo yokuqala

column1: An IPv4 address, or 255.255.255.255 for the universe's multicast group (239.255.x.y)
column2: Ikheli le-IPv4, noma u-255.255.255.255 weqembu le-multicast le-universe (239.255.x.y)

column1: Click a cell to walk it: off, full, -3, -6, -12. This row turns the matrix off again
column2: Chofoza iseli ukulishintsha: valiwe, gcwele, -3, -6, -12. Lo mugqa uvala i-matrix futhi

column1: How long each phrase stays before it moves. Zero hides them without losing the list.
column2: Umusho ngamunye uhlala isikhathi esingakanani ngaphambi kokunyakaza. U-zero uyawafihla ngaphandle kokulahla uhlu.

column1: How long it takes to fall away after the attack. Only audible when retrigger is set.
column2: Isikhathi sokwehla ngemva kokushaya. Kuzwakala kuphela uma ukushaya kabusha kuvuliwe.

column1: Off, from start (next cue fires when this one starts) or from end (when it finishes)
column2: Valiwe, kusukela ekuqaleni (i-cue elandelayo iqala lapho le iqala) noma ekugcineni (uma iphela)

column1: Height of one line as a percent of the raster, so a card reads the same on any screen
column2: Ubude bomugqa owodwa njengephesenti le-raster, ukuze ikhadi lifundeke ngokufanayo kunoma yisiphi isikrini

column1: Set slot source as media:/path, browser:url, window:name, camera:name, or syphon:name
column2: Setha umthombo we-slot njenge-media:/indlela, browser:url, window:igama, camera:igama, noma syphon:igama

column1: Short LFSR mode. The period is brief enough to read as pitched metal rather than hiss.
column2: Imodi emfushane ye-LFSR. Isikhathi sifushane ngokwanele ukuzwakala njengensimbi ecwengekile hhayi ukuhashaza.

column1: White, warm, red, amber, green, cyan, blue, magenta. ~ moves it round the colour wheel
column2: Okumhlophe, okufudumele, okubomvu, i-amber, okuluhlaza, i-cyan, okuluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, i-magenta. U-~ uyayizungezisa esondweni lemibala

column1: Re-strike the envelope this often. Hold sustains one note, which is what a drone wants.
column2: Shaya i-envelope futhi kaningi kanje. I-Hold ibamba inothi elilodwa, okudingwa yi-drone.

column1: Diamond is the hard-edged Atari Video Music lattice; rings tunnel well with feedback zoom.
column2: I-Diamond iyigridi enemiphetho ebukhali ye-Atari Video Music; amasongo enza umhubhe omuhle nge-zoom yempendulo.

column1: Rock or spin. Depth 1 is half a turn either way; a saw at depth 1 turns it all the way round
column2: Ukuntenga noma ukujikeleza. Ukujula 1 kuyingxenye yokujika ohlangothini ngalunye; i-saw ku-1 iyazungeza yonke

column1: DECK playback level (live, not saved with the cue) - per-cue trim is gain in the AUDIO section
column2: Izinga lokudlala le-DECK (bukhoma, aligcinwa ne-cue) - i-trim ye-cue ngayinye iyinzuzo esigabeni se-AUDIO

column1: Still, fade in, typewriter, scroll up, crawl or pulse -- all driven by the cue's own transport
column2: Okumile, ukungena kancane, umshini wokubhala, ukuskrola phezulu, ukukhasa noma ukushaya -- konke kuqhutshwa ukuhamba kwe-cue uqobo

column1: Fields per rendered frame. 1 is one for one, 0.5 holds each field for two frames, 0 freezes it.
column2: Izinkambu ngesithombe ngasinye. U-1 ungowodwa kowodwa, u-0.5 ubamba inkambu ngayinye izithombe ezimbili, u-0 uyamisa.

column1: What this cue shows while it plays: waveform, scope, Lissajous, spectrum, meters or a name card
column2: Okuboniswa yile cue uma idlala: i-waveform, i-scope, i-Lissajous, i-spectrum, amamitha noma ikhadi legama

column1: 0 picks tiles by brightness so the picture reads. 1 picks at random so the grid becomes texture.
column2: U-0 ukhetha amathayela ngokukhanya ukuze isithombe sifundeke. U-1 ukhetha ngokungahleliwe igridi ibe ukuthungwa.

column1: How far it travels, in semitones. Up reads as arrival, down as departure, zero is a struck note.
column2: Ihamba ibanga elingakanani, ngama-semitone. Phezulu kuzwakala njengokufika, phansi njengokuhamba, u-zero inothi elishayiwe.

column1: An IPv4 address. Names are not resolved: a DNS lookup is a blocking call and GO must not make one
column2: Ikheli le-IPv4. Amagama awaxazululwa: ukusesha kwe-DNS kuyavimba futhi i-GO akumele ikwenze

column1: Tile width in pixels. Must match the sheet's grid or the slices land across neighbouring sprites.
column2: Ububanzi bethayela ngamaphikseli. Kumele bufane negridi yeshidi noma izingcezu ziwele kuma-sprite angomakhelwane.

column1: Alternating mirrors by cell position, which reads as pattern where random flipping reads as noise.
column2: Izibuko ezishintshanayo ngendawo yeseli, ezifundeka njengephethini lapho ukuphenduka okungahleliwe kufundeka njengomsindo.

column1: 0 welds them to their cell, which reads as engraved. Above it they re-roll, which reads as boiling.
column2: U-0 uzinamathisela eselini lazo, zifundeke njengezibaziwe. Ngaphezulu ziyaphinda zikhethwe, zifundeke njengokubila.

column1: MONO L plays the left input in both speakers: mic 1 on most interfaces. STEREO is for a line source.
column2: I-MONO L idlala okokufaka kwesobunxele kuzo zombili izipikha: i-mic 1 kuma-interface amaningi. I-STEREO ingeyomthombo womugqa.

column1: The whole gesture. This IS the cue's duration -- a sting is the one generated signal here that ends.
column2: Isenzo sonke. LOKHU kungubude be-cue -- i-sting iyona kuphela isignali eyakhiwe lapha ephelayo.

column1: Click the value to send this fixture or leave it where the last cue put it. ~ makes the level breathe
column2: Chofoza inani ukuthumela lesi sibani noma usishiye lapho i-cue yokugcina isibeke khona. U-~ wenza izinga liphefumule

column1: FDS is a wavetable bent by a modulator. 2A03 is the pulse/triangle/noise set most chiptune is made of.
column2: I-FDS iyi-wavetable egotshwa yi-modulator. I-2A03 iyisethi ye-pulse/triangle/noise okwenziwe ngayo i-chiptune eningi.

column1: Scramble which glyph means which brightness. Same set, different handwriting. Seeded, so it stays put.
column2: Xuba ukuthi iyiphi i-glyph esho ukukhanya okuthile. Isethi efanayo, umbhalo ohlukile. Inembewu, ngakho ihlala injalo.

column1: Pixel sort: runs of pixels sorted by brightness within a row, which is what makes datamosh look melted.
column2: Ukuhlunga amaphikseli: imigqa yamaphikseli ihlungwe ngokukhanya emgqeni, yikho okwenza i-datamosh ibukeke incibilika.

column1: How many cells the marks may climb. They thin out as they go, so a tall reach trails rather than doubles.
column2: Amaseli angaki izimpawu ezingakhuphukela kuwo. Ziyancipha njengoba zikhuphuka, ngakho ukufinyelela okude kushiya umkhondo hhayi ukuphindeka.

column1: cue act val  -  G take  S stop  F fade out (val = tenths of a second)  V volume  O opacity  J jump to row
column2: cue isenzo inani  -  G thatha  S yima  F phuma kancane (inani = okweshumi komzuzwana)  V ivolumu  O ukufiphala  J yeqela emugqeni

column1: Harmonic weight: a pure chime at zero, brass at full. This is the difference between a ping and a fanfare.
column2: Isisindo se-harmonic: insimbi ehlanzekile ku-zero, ithusi lapho kugcwele. Lokhu kungumehluko phakathi kwe-ping ne-fanfare.

column1: Steps through the inputs this computer has. 'Settings input' follows the input chosen in Settings > Audio.
column2: Idlula kokungenayo kwale khompyutha. I-'Settings input' ilandela okokufaka okukhethwe ku-Settings > Audio.

column1: Embers to roaring. It still surges and settles at any setting -- a fire that does not move reads as a photo
column2: Kusukela emalahleni kuya emlilweni ovuthayo. Isavuka futhi izole kunoma yiliphi izinga -- umlilo ongahambi ubukeka njengesithombe

column1: Reference pitch. 440 is modern standard, 432 the common alternative, and older instruments sat lower still.
column2: Iphimbo lereferensi. U-440 uyindinganiso yanamuhla, u-432 enye evamile, futhi izinsimbi ezindala zazingaphansi kakhulu.

column1: Where the sting starts. Under a voice it wants to stay out of the way; over a room it wants to cut through.
column2: Lapho i-sting iqala khona. Ngaphansi kwezwi ifuna ukungaphazamisi; phezu kwegumbi ifuna ukudabula.

column1: Digital gain on the input, -40 to +40 dB. Set the interface's own preamp first; this is for the last few dB.
column2: Inzuzo yedijithali kokungenayo, -40 kuya ku-+40 dB. Setha i-preamp ye-interface kuqala; lokhu kungama-dB ambalwa okugcina.

column1: Pulse the size. On its own this moves width AND height together; give height its own ~ to squash and stretch
column2: Shaya usayizi. Uwodwa uhambisa ububanzi NOBUDE ndawonye; nikeza ubude u-~ wabo ukuze ucindezele futhi welule

column1: A card fills the frame; a Lower Third is a name and a role, low on a transparent frame, with an in and an out
column2: Ikhadi ligcwalisa isithombe; i-Lower Third yigama nendima, phansi esithombeni esibonakalayo, kungena futhi kuphuma

column1: Held keeps the last displacement rather than removing it -- the picture stays bent the way the driver left it.
column2: I-Held igcina ukususwa kokugcina esikhundleni sokukususa -- isithombe sihlala sigobile njengoba umshayeli esishiyile.

column1: 12.5 and 25 are thin and reedy, 50 is hollow. 75 sounds identical to 25 -- it is here because trackers expose it.
column2: U-12.5 no-25 bancane futhi bayakhala ngekhala, u-50 ungenalutho. U-75 uzwakala ngokufana no-25 -- ukhona ngoba ama-tracker ayabonisa.

column1: Quantise the output like the hardware. The steps ARE the sound; smoothing them makes it a synth imitating a chip.
column2: Linganisa okuphumayo njengehadiwe. Izinyathelo ZIWUMSINDO; ukuzithambisa kwenza kube yi-synth elingisa i-chip.

column1: Moves every selected cue's trim by the same dB, keeping the differences between them; typing a value sets them all to it
column2: Ihambisa i-trim yayo yonke i-cue ekhethiwe nge-dB efanayo, igcina umehluko phakathi kwazo; ukuthayipha inani kuzisetha zonke kulo

column1: Where the playlist's crosspoints send it (Settings > Audio). Click to open the matrix by name, starting from exactly that
column2: Lapho amaphoyinti okuwela e-playlist ayithumela khona (Settings > Audio). Chofoza ukuvula i-matrix ngegama, kusukela kulowo mzila ngqo

column1: name values with  d = ...;  end with one expression, or three for red green blue  |  Shift+Enter: new line  |  Enter: apply
column2: qamba amanani nge-  d = ...;  qeda ngesisho esisodwa, noma ezintathu okubomvu okuluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka  |  Shift+Enter: umugqa omusha  |  Enter: faka

column1: Put back what it started from once the ramp lands (after the stop): a deck left ready for its next cue, a swell that lets go
column2: Buyisela lokho ekuqale kukho uma i-ramp ifika (ngemva kokuma): i-deck ilungele i-cue yayo elandelayo, ukukhuphuka okudedelayo

column1: Which speech model makes the captions: English, any language, or the slower, more accurate pair. Each is a one-time download
column2: Iyiphi imodeli yokukhuluma eyenza amagama: isiNgisi, noma yiluphi ulimi, noma ipheya ehamba kancane enembayo. Ngayinye ilandwa kanye

column1: What the mask cuts: this cue wherever it plays, this playlist on the focused output, that output's whole picture, or its matte
column2: Lokho okusikwa imaski: le cue noma ngabe idlala kuphi, le playlist kokuphumayo okugxilwe kukho, isithombe sonke salokho okuphumayo, noma i-matte yakho

column1: Play at the screen's rate when it is within 0.2% (59.94 on 60): every frame shown once, the sound up to 3.5 cents sharp or flat
column2: Dlala ngesivinini sesikrini uma singaphakathi kuka-0.2% (59.94 ku-60): isithombe ngasinye sibonwa kanye, umsindo ukhuphuke noma wehle kuze kufike ku-3.5 cents

column1: Quarter turns are exact and stay crisp. Spinning samples at an angle, which tears pixel art -- sometimes that is what you want.
column2: Ukujika kwekota kunembile futhi kuhlala kucacile. Ukujikeleza kuthatha amasampula nge-engeli, okudabula ubuciko bamaphikseli -- ngezinye izikhathi yilokho okufunayo.

column1: Every take starts the puppetry the same way, so a rehearsed look repeats instead of depending on how long the app has been open.
column2: I-take ngayinye iqala ukunyakaza ngendlela efanayo, ukuze ukubukeka okuzijwayezwe kuphindeke kungancikile ekutheni uhlelo luvulwe isikhathi esingakanani.

column1: What aims each tilt: its own position, the picture's luma gradient so characters lean the way the image does, or the cell's hue.
column2: Okuqondisa ukutsheka ngakunye: indawo yakho, i-gradient yokukhanya kwesithombe ukuze izinhlamvu zitsheke njengesithombe, noma umbala weseli.

column1: Name a channel or a pair once. Playlists send to the name, so a different interface means changing the names here, not every cue.
column2: Qamba isiteshi noma ipheya kanye. Ama-playlist athumela egameni, ngakho i-interface ehlukile isho ukushintsha amagama lapha, hhayi i-cue ngayinye.

column1: Click a crosspoint to walk it: off, 0, -3, -6, -12 dB. Drag it sideways for any level. A playlist with none plays to its own device.
column2: Chofoza iphoyinti lokuwela ukulishintsha: valiwe, 0, -3, -6, -12 dB. Lihudule eceleni ngezinga elithile. I-playlist engenalo idlala kudivayisi yayo.

column1: Sprite sets installed in data/sprites. Each folder there is a set; cycling picks one and wraps back to none. Right-click turns them off.
column2: Amasethi ama-sprite afakwe ku-data/sprites. Ifolda ngayinye iyisethi; ukushintsha kukhetha eyodwa bese kubuyela kulutho. Ukuchofoza kwesokudla kuyawavala.

column1: Internal resolution, 1 chunkiest to 5 finest. This is an aesthetic control as much as a speed one -- the 8-bit look comes from big pixels.
column2: Isixazululo sangaphakathi, u-1 omkhulu kakhulu kuya ku-5 omncane kakhulu. Lokhu kungukulawula ukubukeka njengokulawula isivinini -- ukubukeka kwe-8-bit kuvela kumaphikseli amakhulu.

column1: Picture takes colour from the image. Green, amber and cyan are terminal phosphors. Palette locks the text to the selected hardware palette.
column2: I-Picture ithatha umbala esithombeni. Okuluhlaza, i-amber ne-cyan zingama-phosphor e-terminal. I-Palette ikhiyela umbhalo kuphalethi yehadiwe ekhethiwe.

column1: SUBTLE self-heals (H.264). CLASSIC is the real smear (MPEG-4). EXTREME is chunkier and smears constantly. Changing this re-prepares the cue.
column2: I-SUBTLE iyazelapha (H.264). I-CLASSIC iyindlela yangempela yokugcoba (MPEG-4). I-EXTREME inkulu futhi igcoba njalo. Ukushintsha lokhu kulungisa i-cue kabusha.

column1: Sine for line-up, pink to ring out a PA, white to find rattles, sweep to hear where a room rings, identify to walk the outputs one at a time.
column2: I-sine yokuqondanisa, i-pink yokulungisa i-PA, i-white yokuthola ukuhlokoma, i-sweep yokuzwa lapho igumbi likhala khona, i-identify yokuhamba kokuphumayo ngakunye.

column1: Which effect, by its place in the stack of the cue that deck is playing when this fires. With nothing there, the fade says so and does nothing
column2: Imiphi imiphumela, ngendawo yayo esitakini se-cue edlalwa yileyo deck lapho lokhu kuqala. Uma kungekho lutho, ukufiphala kusho kanjalo futhi akwenzi lutho

column1: Each frame blended into the next. This is the Hypno signature -- at 0 it is a pattern generator, above it the picture starts feeding on itself.
column2: Isithombe ngasinye sixutshwa nesilandelayo. Lesi yisiginesha ye-Hypno -- ku-0 iyijeneretha yephethini, ngaphezulu isithombe siqala ukuzondla ngokwaso.

column1: What is through the window on the hearth wall: a garden, rain, snow or the sea. A room with weather outside reads as somewhere rather than as a wall
column2: Okubonakala ewindini lodonga lweziko: ingadi, imvula, iqhwa noma ulwandle. Igumbi elinesimo sezulu ngaphandle lifundeka njengendawo hhayi udonga

column1: BY FIXTURE: the lights in the patch (Settings > Network > FIXTURES), by name. CHANNELS: channel=level by hand. A cue can carry both; channels go last
column2: NGESIBANI: izibani ku-patch (Settings > Network > FIXTURES), ngegama. IZITESHI: isiteshi=izinga ngesandla. I-cue ingathwala kokubili; iziteshi zigcina

column1: Each character rocks as though it were a card being tilted. Every cell has its own phase, so the grid breathes instead of sliding about as one sheet.
column2: Uhlamvu ngalunye luyantenga njengekhadi elitshekiswayo. Iseli ngalinye linesigaba salo, ngakho igridi iyaphefumula esikhundleni sokushelela njengeshidi elilodwa.

column1: Pen: click for corners, drag for curves, click the first point to close (P). Points: drag, click the outline to add one, Alt-click or Delete to remove
column2: Ipeni: chofoza amakhona, hudula ama-curve, chofoza iphoyinti lokuqala ukuvala (P). Amaphoyinti: hudula, chofoza unqenqema ukwengeza, Alt-chofoza noma Delete ukususa

column1: The chip's three channels. They differ in kind: triangle has no volume control on the hardware, and noise is a shift register rather than an oscillator.
column2: Iziteshi ezintathu ze-chip. Zihlukile ngohlobo: i-triangle ayinakho ukulawula ivolumu kuhadiwe, futhi i-noise iyi-shift register hhayi i-oscillator.

column1: Curated sets of symbols and emoji -- stars, notes, flowers, arrows, weather, runes, faces. Picking one fills the custom glyphs below, which stays editable.
column2: Amasethi akhethiwe ezimpawu ne-emoji -- izinkanyezi, amanothi, izimbali, imicibisholo, isimo sezulu, ama-rune, ubuso. Ukukhetha esisodwa kugcwalisa ama-glyph angezansi, ahlala ehleleka.

column1: Play from the computer keyboard, Ableton layout: A W S E D F T G Y H U J, Z and X for octave. While this is ON those keys make notes instead of firing cues.

column1: Scanlines, phosphor bloom and RGB fringing. The bloom is the part that matters -- a phosphor spills sideways, which is why a CRT looks like it is emitting light.
column2: Imigqa yokuskena, ukukhanya kwe-phosphor nemiphetho ye-RGB. Ukukhanya kubalulekile -- i-phosphor ichitheka eceleni, yingakho i-CRT ibukeka sengathi ikhipha ukukhanya.

column1: Torn scanline bands and RGB separation. In text mode it also corrupts CELLS -- whole rows lock to one repeating character, the way a real text screen loses sync.
column2: Amabhande emigqa adabukile nokwahlukana kwe-RGB. Kumodi yombhalo yonakalisa nama-SELI -- imigqa yonke ikhiyeka kuhlamvu olulodwa oluphindayo, njengesikrini sombhalo sangempela silahlekelwa ukuvumelana.

column1: Still holds the frame you are on. Flipbook plays the frames in turn. Replay draws the first frame stroke by stroke, the way it was drawn, then holds and starts again
column2: I-Still ibamba isithombe okuso. I-Flipbook idlala izithombe ngokulandelana. I-Replay idweba isithombe sokuqala umvimbo ngomvimbo, njengoba sadwetshwa, bese ibamba iqale futhi

column1: Start, Stop, Pause, Resume, Load (stand it by without firing), Arm, Disarm, or Devamp it (a loop plays out its pass and ends); or Stop all, Pause all, Resume all: every deck
column2: Start, Stop, Pause, Resume, Load (yilungiselele ngaphandle kokuyiqala), Arm, Disarm, noma Devamp (i-loop iqeda umjikelezo wayo bese iyaphela); noma Stop all, Pause all, Resume all: yonke i-deck

column1: Scope shows shape and clipping. Lissajous shows phase and polarity between the first two channels -- a diagonal the wrong way means one is inverted. Spectrum is third-octave bars.
column2: I-Scope ibonisa isimo nokusikeka. I-Lissajous ibonisa isigaba nokubhekisa phakathi kweziteshi ezimbili zokuqala -- i-diagonal ebheke ngendlela engeyiyo isho ukuthi esinye siphendukile. I-Spectrum ingamabha engxenye yesithathu ye-octave.

column1: 0 picks the glyph the brightness asks for, 1 picks any glyph in the set. Turn it up to see the whole alphabet: ranked strictly by ink, a flat area picks one mark and the rest never appear.
column2: U-0 ukhetha i-glyph ecelwa ukukhanya, u-1 ukhetha noma iyiphi i-glyph esethini. Yikhuphule ukuze ubone lonke uhlamvu: uma kuhlelwe ngokuqinile ngoyinki, indawo eyisicaba ikhetha uphawu olulodwa nezinye azibonakali.

column1: Blocks and dithers read as density; the ASCII ramp reads as text; symbols read as wreckage. Cycling this clears a custom glyph string, since that would override it -- the preset row puts one back.
column2: Amabhulokhi nama-dither afundeka njengobuningi; i-ASCII ramp ifundeka njengombhalo; izimpawu zifundeka njengemfucuza. Ukushintsha lokhu kusula uchungechunge lwe-glyph oluzenzele, ngoba lungalweqa -- umugqa we-preset ubuyisa olulodwa.

column1: Equal temperament buys free modulation at the cost of every interval being slightly wrong. Just and pythagorean are exactly in tune in one key. Bohlen-Pierce divides a twelfth, so it has no octaves.
column2: I-equal temperament ithenga ukushintsha kwekhiye ngokukhululeka ngentengo yokuthi ibanga ngalinye libe nephutha elincane. I-just ne-pythagorean zihambisana ngqo kukhiye owodwa. I-Bohlen-Pierce ihlukanisa i-twelfth, ngakho ayinawo ama-octave.

column1: BLEND PAIR: expected <other output number> <overlap in pixels>
column2: BLEND PAIR: kudingeka <inombolo yokunye okuphumayo> <ukudlulela ngamaphikseli>

column1: Below the middle narrows toward mono -- which is what a single PA cluster is. Above it widens.
column2: Ngaphansi kwaphakathi kunciphisa kuye ku-mono -- okuyindlela yeqoqo elilodwa lezipikha PA. Ngaphezulu kwakhona kuyanwebeka.

column1: Blueshift toward the direction of travel and redshift at the rim. Zero leaves the colour alone and it reads as a lens instead.
column2: Kushintshela koluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka lapho kuya khona nokubomvu onqenqemeni. Uziro ugcina umbala ufana futhi kubukeka njengelensi.

column1: Bright: bright things drip over the dark, as text and logos do. Whole picture: everything is wax, and the picture itself runs down in its own colours.
column2: Okukhanyayo: izinto ezikhanyayo ziconsela ebumnyameni, njengombhalo namalogo. Isithombe sonke: konke kuyi-wax, isithombe sigelezela phansi ngemibala yaso.

column1: Centre is a straight line. Up bends it into an S -- darker shadows, brighter highlights, more contrast. Down flattens it.
column2: Phakathi kungumugqa oqondile. Phezulu kugoba kube u-S -- izithunzi ezimnyama, izindawo ezikhanyayo, ukugqama okuningi. Phansi kuyasithelelisa.

column1: Characters across. Fewer means bigger cells and less of the picture surviving, which is usually the point.
column2: Izinhlamvu ngobubanzi. Ezimbalwa zenza amaseli amakhulu nesithombe esincane esisele, okuvame ukuba yinhloso.

column1: Characters to build the picture from, darkest first. Empty uses the chosen glyph set.
column2: Izinhlamvu zokwakha isithombe, ezimnyama kuqala. Akunalutho kusebenzisa iqoqo lezimpawu elikhethiwe.

column1: Colour is recorded at a fraction of the detail: it smears sideways, lands late and its hue wanders.
column2: Umbala uqoshwa ngemininingwane embalwa: ugcwala emaceleni, ufika sekwephuzile futhi ithoni yawo iyazulazula.

column1: DASH SET: needs a command -- DASH SET <n> <label> | <command> [| <glyph>]
column2: DASH SET: kudingeka umyalo -- DASH SET <n> <label> | <command> [| <glyph>]

column1: DMXCUE SET: expected channel=level pairs, e.g. 1=255,10-14=64
column2: DMXCUE SET: kudingeka amapheya channel=level, isib. 1=255,10-14=64

column1: DRAW COLOUR: #rrggbb, #rrggbbaa, a name, or 1-8 for the palette
DRAW TOOL: brush, erase, line, box, oval or fill
column2: DRAW TOOL: brush, erase, line, box, oval noma fill

column1: FADE TO: a speed from 0.25 to 4 (0.5 is half speed, an octave down)
column2: FADE TO: isivinini esisuka ku-0.25 kuya ku-4 (0.5 uhhafu wesivinini, i-octave eyodwa phansi)

column1: FADE WHAT: expected opacity, volume, dimmer, brightness, contrast, saturation, hue, effect, audiofx or speed
column2: FADE WHAT: kudingeka opacity, volume, dimmer, brightness, contrast, saturation, hue, effect, audiofx noma speed

column1: FX LFO: on, off, shape, rate, depth, zone, channel or cc
column2: FX LFO: on, off, shape, rate, depth, zone, channel noma cc
