column2: FX: sebenzisa LIST | ADD <effect> [amount] | AMOUNT <n> <v> | PARAM <n> <A-F> <0-1> | CHOICE <n> <A|B> <name> | LFO <n> <A-G> ... | COPY | PASTE | CLEAR

column1: Fields per frame, 0-4 (1 = one field per rendered frame) (supports + - * / and ())
column2: Izinkambu ngefremu, 0-4 (1 = inkambu eyodwa ngefremu enikeziwe) (isekela + - * / kanye no-())

column1: Flip across, upside down or both, or fold one half onto the other: right onto left, left onto right, bottom onto top, top onto bottom, or one corner into all four.
column2: Phendula ngokuvundla, ubhekise phansi noma kokubili, noma ugoqe uhhafu phezu komunye: kwesokudla phezu kwesobunxele, kwesobunxele phezu kwesokudla, phansi phezu phezulu, phezulu phezu phansi, noma ikhoneni elilodwa kuwo omane.

column1: GEOLFO: x, y, width, height, rotation, cropleft, cropright, croptop or cropbottom
column2: GEOLFO: x, y, width, height, rotation, cropleft, cropright, croptop noma cropbottom

column1: How bright a pixel has to be to join a run. Lower catches more of the picture and the runs grow longer.
column2: Ukukhanya iphikseli elikudingayo ukuze lijoyine umugqa. Okuphansi kuthatha isithombe esiningi nemigqa ibe mide.

column1: How faint a gradient still registers. High turns the quietest shading into visible structure.
column2: Ubuthakathaka begradiyenti esakwazi ukubonakala. Okuphezulu kwenza nokufiphala okuncane kubonakale njengesakhiwo.

column1: How far back the chain listens. The picture is played through a delay, so this is the distance the damage is dragged across.
column2: Ubude bokubuyela emuva iketango elilalelayo. Isithombe sidlalwa ngokubambezeleka, ngakho leli yibanga umonakalo ohudulwa kulo.

column1: How far the burn spreads off the edge, and how hot its colour runs.
column2: Ukude ukusha okusabalala kusuka onqenqemeni, nokushisa kombala wako.

column1: How far the colour turns on each trip round the loop. This is the oil-slick: the trail walks through the spectrum instead of fading.
column2: Ukuthi umbala ujika kangakanani ngomjikelezo ngamunye. Lokhu kufana namafutha: umkhondo udlula kuyo yonke imibala esikhundleni sokufiphala.

column1: How far the picture stands out. Bright parts come forward, dark parts stay back. At the left it is flat.
column2: Ukuthi isithombe siphuma kangakanani. Okukhanyayo kuza phambili, okumnyama kusale emuva. Ngakwesobunxele siyisicaba.

column1: How far the picture swings the filter. The cue's own brightness opens and closes it, so a cut to black takes the top off the sound.
column2: Ukuthi isithombe sisinyakazisa kangakanani isihlungi. Ukukhanya kwe-cue kuyasivula kusivale, ngakho ukusika kube mnyama kususa amafrikhwensi aphezulu emsindweni.

column1: How far the top comes down as the end approaches. This is not a fade: the level is left alone.
column2: Ukuthi amafrikhwensi aphezulu ehla kangakanani lapho kusondela isiphetho. Lokhu akuyona i-fade: izinga lomsindo ligcinwa.

column1: How fast it settles away while held. At zero it holds indefinitely, which is what room tone under a held title wants.
column2: Ukushesha kokunyamalala lapho kubanjiwe. Kuziro kuhlala njalo, njengomsindo wegumbi ngaphansi kwesihloko esimile.

column1: How fast the open slit crosses the picture. Slow smears a long moment across the frame.
column2: Ukushesha kwesikhala esivulekile lapho siwela isithombe. Kancane kusabalalisa umzuzu omude kuyo yonke ifremu.

column1: How fast the wave travels. Faster spreads further in the same time and interferes more.
column2: Ukushesha kokuhamba kwegagasi. Okusheshayo kusabalala kude ngesikhathi esifanayo bese kuphazamisana kakhulu.

column1: How fast what has dripped hardens away. At the left the drips stay until the cue changes.
column2: Ukushesha kokuqina nokunyamalala kokuconsile. Ngakwesobunxele amaconsi ahlala kuze kushintshe i-cue.

column1: How fine the water is. Long ocean swell at one end, rain on a puddle at the other.
column2: Ubuncane bamagagasi amanzi. Amagagasi olwandle amade ngakolunye uhlangothi, imvula echibini ngakolunye.

column1: How hard the light gathers where the rays converge. This is the part that makes it read as water rather than as a wobble.
column2: Ukuqoqana kokukhanya lapho imisebe ihlangana khona. Lokhu kwenza kubonakale njengamanzi kunokunyakaza nje.

column1: How hard the moving parts throw sand. More shake clears the plate faster and makes the lines thinner.
column2: Amandla izingxenye ezinyakazayo eziphonsa ngawo isihlabathi. Ukunyakaza okuningi kusula ipuleti ngokushesha futhi kwenze imigqa ibe mincane.

column1: How long a grain is, in VIDEO FRAMES. On a 23.976 clip one frame is 41.7ms, which is not a musical value and is exactly the point.
column2: Ubude bohlamvu, ngamafremu EVIDIYO. Esiqeshaneni esingu-23.976 ifremu eyodwa ingu-41.7ms, okungelona inani lomculo futhi kuyiyona nhloso.

column1: How long before the end it starts. The cue has to have a known length -- an open-ended one has no end to resolve into.
column2: Isikhathi ngaphambi kwesiphetho okuqala ngaso. I-cue idinga ubude obaziwayo -- evulekile ayinaso isiphetho sokuxazululela kuso.

column1: How long the old waves linger when the note changes. Left: they die at once. Right: they slosh for a while.
column2: Ukuthi amagagasi amadala ahlala isikhathi esingakanani lapho inothi lishintsha. Kwesobunxele: afa ngokushesha. Kwesokudla: anyakaza isikhashana.

column1: How much each facet catches the light, which is what makes them read as faceted rather than as flat blobs.
column2: Ukuthi uhlangothi ngalunye lubamba ukukhanya kangakanani, ukuze lubonakale lunezicaba ezihlukene kunamabala ayisicaba.

column1: How much its SIZE becomes distance. Shrink the picture and the sound goes away from you: the top comes off, the image narrows, the level drops.
column2: Ukuthi USAYIZI uba ibanga kangakanani. Nciphisa isithombe nomsindo uyasuka kuwe: okuphezulu kuyancipha, ububanzi bomsindo buyancipha, nezinga liyehla.

column1: How much of the bent picture goes round again. High is where it stops being an echo and starts eating itself.
column2: Ubungako besithombe esigobile obujikeleza futhi. Okuphezulu kuyeka ukuba yi-echo bese kuqala ukuzidla.

column1: How much of the driver's movement the picture KEEPS. At zero it follows the driver frame by frame, which is a twitch. Wind it up and the motion accumulates, so the driver sculpts the picture over time and it holds the pose -- which is what puppetry means.
column2: Ukuthi isithombe SIGCINA ukunyakaza komshayeli kangakanani. Kuziro silandela ifremu ngayinye, kube ukuqhaqhazela. Kukhuphule ukunyakaza kuqoqeke, umshayeli abumbe isithombe ngokuhamba kwesikhathi sigcine isimo -- njengopopayi odonswa ngezintambo.

column1: How much of the picture's position on the output is used. A PIP on the left sounds on the left -- and it is a placement, not a pan: the far ear gets the delay and the head shadow too.
column2: Ukuthi kusetshenziswa kangakanani indawo yesithombe kokuphumayo. I-PIP kwesobunxele izwakala kwesobunxele -- yindawo, akuyona i-pan: indlebe ekude ithola ukubambezeleka nesithunzi sekhanda.

column1: How much of the tail is kept going while the cue is held. Long enough to hide the splice in room tone, short enough not to smear a rhythm in it.
column2: Ubungako bomsila oqhubekayo lapho i-cue ibanjiwe. Ube mude ukufihla ukuhlanganisa emsindweni wegumbi, ube mfushane ukuze ungafiphazi isigqi.

column1: How much room comes up under it, so the sound settles into the cut instead of being severed.
column2: Ubungako bomsindo wegumbi obuvela ngaphansi kwawo, ukuze umsindo uphumule ekusikeni esikhundleni sokunqunywa.

column1: How much the echo is distorted each pass. It compounds, so a little ripples and a lot melts the picture into itself.
column2: Ukuthi i-echo ihlanekezelwa kangakanani ngomjikelezo ngamunye. Kuyaqoqeka: okuncane kudala amagagasi, okuningi kuncibilikise isithombe phakathi kwaso.

column1: How much the material draws in towards each drip, so it runs as a thin neck with a heavier head.
column2: Ukuthi into ihlangana kangakanani ngaseconsini ngalinye, yenze intamo encane nekhanda elisindayo.

column1: How often its settings are corrupted. Corrupted far enough it oscillates on its own -- loud, but it cannot run away.
column2: Ukuvama kokonakala kwezilungiselelo. Uma konakele ngokwanele kuyazishwiba -- kukhulu umsindo, kodwa akukwazi ukuphunyuka emkhawulweni.

column1: How quickly the picture springs back to rest once the driver stops pushing it. Only does anything when memory is up.
column2: Ukushesha kokubuyela kwesithombe ekuphumuleni lapho umshayeli eyeka ukusisunduza. Kusebenza kuphela lapho inkumbulo ikhuphukile.

column1: How small a cut sets it off. With no picture it runs on a timer instead, and this is how often.
column2: Ukuncane kokusika okusiqalisa. Ngaphandle kwesithombe sisebenzisa isibali sikhathi, lokhu kusetha ukuvama.

column1: How strongly the finished picture pushes the bend. Pair it with a picture effect whose LFO is set to Audio and the two drive each other.
column2: Amandla isithombe esiqediwe esisunduza ngawo ukugoba. Sibhanqe nomphumela wesithombe one-LFO esethwe ku-Audio ukuze kushayelane.

column1: LFO: density, speed, warp, turn, centrex, centrey, grey or hue
column2: LFO: density, speed, warp, turn, centrex, centrey, grey noma hue

column1: Lift or cut, 12dB either way. The centre is flat, so a band that has just been added does nothing until this is moved.
column2: Nyusa noma wehlise, 12dB nhlangothi zombili. Phakathi kuyisicaba, ibhande elisha alenzi lutho kuze kunyikinywe lokhu.

column1: Light on the drips, as on something wet: a gloss where it faces the light, darker where it curls away.
column2: Ukukhanya emaconsini, njengento emanzi: ukucwebezela lapho kubheke ekukhanyeni, ubumnyama lapho kugobela kude.

column1: MASK SET: expected INVERT, X, Y, SCALE, ROTATION, FEATHER, GROW or OPACITY and a number
column2: MASK SET: kudingeka INVERT, X, Y, SCALE, ROTATION, FEATHER, GROW noma OPACITY nenombolo

column1: MIDIIN: NOTE <n> <vel>, NOTEOFF <n>, CC <c> <v>, PITCH <0-16383>, PRESSURE <v>, KEYPRESSURE <n> <v>, PROGRAM <n> or OSC <address> [<n>], then CH <1-16> if not channel 1
column2: MIDIIN: NOTE <n> <vel>, NOTEOFF <n>, CC <c> <v>, PITCH <0-16383>, PRESSURE <v>, KEYPRESSURE <n> <v>, PROGRAM <n> noma OSC <address> [<n>], bese CH <1-16> uma kungesona isiteshi 1

column1: MIDIMAP: LIST, ADD, SET, REMOVE, CLEAR, RESET, LEARN, LEARNED, PRESET or FEEDBACK
column2: MIDIMAP: LIST, ADD, SET, REMOVE, CLEAR, RESET, LEARN, LEARNED, PRESET noma FEEDBACK

column1: MULTIVIEW WINDOW <n>: expected a source, or SAFE/METER/LABEL ON|OFF
column2: MULTIVIEW WINDOW <n>: kudingeka umthombo, noma SAFE/METER/LABEL ON|OFF

column1: Moves the direction of travel off the centre of frame, so the picture rushes past rather than straight at you.
column2: Isusa indlela yokuhamba maphakathi nefremu, ukuze isithombe sidlule eceleni kwakho kunokuza ngqo kuwe.

column1: N=new  Enter/P=previous  O=open saved  E=examples  L=learn  1-
column2: N=okusha  Enter/P=okwedlule  O=vula okulondoloziwe  E=izibonelo  L=funda  1-

column2: NMOS: AYIBHALISI - inethiwekhi EYASEKHAYA KUPHELA (vula REMOTE ON ukuze ushicilele)

column1: OUTPUT SPOUT: ON | OFF | TOGGLE | NAME <sender name>
column2: OUTPUT SPOUT: ON | OFF | TOGGLE | NAME <igama lomthumeli>

column1: One knob for the whole balance: below the middle is darker, above it is brighter.
column2: Iknobhu eyodwa yokulinganisa konke: ngaphansi kwaphakathi kumnyama, ngaphezulu kuyakhanya.

column1: Original: the picture pulled onto the figure. Sand: the picture as grains that are thrown off the moving parts and pour into each new figure. Fluid: the picture under water on the plate, bent and lit by its standing waves.
column2: Okwasekuqaleni: isithombe sidonselwa esimweni. Isihlabathi: isithombe siyizinhlamvu eziphonswa yizingxenye ezinyakazayo bese zigelezela esimweni esisha ngasinye. Uketshezi: isithombe singaphansi kwamanzi epuletini, sigotshwa sikhanyiswe amagagasi aso amile.

column1: PHONE LEVEL: removed -- a paired phone or the passphrase can do everything; BLACKOUT and RECORD are hold-to-fire on the phone
column2: PHONE LEVEL: isusiwe -- ifoni ebhanqiwe noma umushwana wokungena ungenza konke; BLACKOUT no-RECORD kudinga ukubamba ukuze kusebenze ocingweni

column1: PowerPoint could not export this file (it may need permission to be automated: System Settings > Privacy & Security > Automation)
column2: I-PowerPoint ayikwazanga ukuthumela leli fayela (ingadinga imvume yokulawulwa ngokuzenzakalela: Izilungiselelo Zesistimu > Ubumfihlo Nokuphepha > Ukuzenzakalela)

column1: Pulls the bright tones down without moving pure white, so a hot highlight rolls off instead of clipping.
column2: Yehlisa amathoni akhanyayo ngaphandle kokunyakazisa okumhlophe qwa, ukuze ukukhanya okukhulu kwehle ngokushelela kunokunqamuka.

column1: Rotates the reading, so straight lines wind into spirals rather than rings.
column2: Ijika ukufunda, imigqa eqondile ibe yizivunguvungu kunezindilinga.

column1: Rows lose sync and repeat one character, the way a real text screen breaks up. At 0 the grid is clean.
column2: Imigqa ilahlekelwa ukuvumelanisa iphindaphinde uhlamvu, njengokuphazamiseka kwesikrini sangempela sombhalo. Ku-0 igridi ihlanzekile.

column2: SLICE EDGE: L, R, T noma B, bese 0-50 (% wocezu)

column2: SLICE ROTATE: IN (okusikiwe) noma OUT (isithombe esibekiwe), bese amadigri

column1: Scanlines, bloom and gun misalignment, 0-1 (supports + - * / and ())
column2: Imigqa yokuskena, ukukhazimula nokungahlangani kwezibhamu, 0-1 (isekela + - * / kanye no-())

column1: Something near the deck: a phone's buzz, a light dimmer's herringbone, a radio's slow bars.
column2: Okuthile eduze kwedekhi: ukuduma kwefoni, iphethini ye-dimmer yesibani, amabha ahamba kancane omsakazo.

column1: Takes out everything brighter than this as well. Left takes out nothing.
column2: Isusa nakho konke okukhanya ngaphezu kwalokhu. Kwesobunxele ayisusi lutho.

column1: Takes out everything darker than this, so what lies beneath shows through. Left takes out nothing.
column2: Isusa konke okumnyama kunalokhu ukuze kubonakale okungaphansi. Kwesobunxele ayisusi lutho.

column1: Tape speed: SP is the best picture, LP and EP fit more on a tape and lose detail and colour.
column2: Isivinini setheyiphu: SP inesithombe esihle kakhulu, LP no-EP kufaka okuningi kutheyiphu kodwa kulahlekelwa imininingwane nombala.

column1: The brightness that stays put. Everything above it reaches one way and everything below it the other.
column2: Ukukhanya okunganyakazi. Konke okungaphezulu kunwebeka ngenye indlela, konke okungezansi ngenye.

column1: The character of the growth: low is waves, then labyrinth, coral, worms, and holes at the top.
column2: Uhlobo lokukhula: phansi amagagasi, kulandele izindlela ezididayo, amakhorali, izibungu, nezimbobo phezulu.

column1: The colour it becomes. Shading and brightness stay as they were, so a red shirt turns blue and keeps its folds.
column2: Umbala okuba yiwo. Ukufiphala nokukhanya kugcinwa, ihembe elibomvu libe luhlaza okwesibhakabhaka ligcine imigoqo yalo.

column1: The distance that sits ON the screen. Either side of it comes forward or falls behind.
column2: Ibanga elihlezi ESIKRININI. Kuzo zombili izinhlangothi kuza phambili noma kuhlehle.

column1: The frequency it pivots around -- what counts as 'low' and 'high' for the tilt.
column2: Ifrikhwensi ejikeleza kuyo -- okubalwa njengokuthi 'phansi' nokuthi 'phezulu' ekutshekeni.

column1: The level below which the source is closed. Set it under the quietest thing you want to hear.
column2: Izinga umthombo ovalwa ngaphansi kwalo. Libeke ngaphansi kwento ethule kakhulu ofuna ukuyizwa.

column1: The level it starts working at. Lower catches more of the performance.
column2: Izinga okuqala ukusebenza kulo. Eliphansi lithatha okuningi kokudlalwayo.

column1: The plugin's first four automatable controls, in its own order. Everything else it has keeps whatever the plugin was left set to.
column2: Izilawuli ezine zokuqala ze-plugin ezikwazi ukuzenzakalela, ngokulandelana kwayo. Konke okunye kugcina izilungiselelo zokugcina ze-plugin.

column1: Tints the two directions apart, so light bending one way and the other are different colours instead of both being grey.
column2: Ifaka imibala ehlukene ezinhlangothini zombili, ukukhanya okugobela ngapha nangapha kube nemibala ehlukene kunokuba mpunga kokubili.

column1: Turns the strokes across the grain instead of along it, which combs the picture apart rather than smoothing it.
column2: Ijika imivimbo inqamule izinhlamvu kunokuzilandela, ihlukanise isithombe njengokukama kunokusithambisa.

column1: Turns the whole arrangement, so the fold lines do not sit on the same part of the picture all night.
column2: Ijika ukuhleleka konke, imigqa yokugoqa ingahlali engxenyeni efanayo yesithombe ubusuku bonke.

column1: VIDEO OUTPUT ASSIGN: already on this output, or no such deck or output
column2: VIDEO OUTPUT ASSIGN: isivele ikulokhu okuphumayo, noma ayikho leyo dekhi noma okuphumayo

column1: VIDEO OUTPUT LAYER: this deck is not on this output, or it is already at that layer
column2: VIDEO OUTPUT LAYER: le dekhi ayikho kulokhu okuphumayo, noma isivele ikulolo ungqimba

column1: VIDEO OUTPUT LAYERWARP MODE: linear or perspective
column2: VIDEO OUTPUT LAYERWARP MODE: linear noma perspective

column1: VIDEO OUTPUT LAYERWARP: expected OFF, MODE, or eight numbers clockwise from the top left
column2: VIDEO OUTPUT LAYERWARP: kudingeka OFF, MODE, noma izinombolo eziyisishiyagalombili ngokwewashi kusuka phezulu kwesobunxele

column1: VIDEO OUTPUT UNASSIGN: this deck is not on this output, or it is the only thing on it
column2: VIDEO OUTPUT UNASSIGN: le dekhi ayikho kulokhu okuphumayo, noma iyona yodwa ekukho

column2: WARP SELECT: kudingeka TL, TR, BR, BL noma igridi <col> <row>

column2: WEBMONITOR PIN: ukwabelana ngenethiwekhi nokulawula ngefoni kudinga izinhlamvu ezingu-8 noma ngaphezulu

column2: WEBMONITOR: STATUS | ON | OFF | CONTROL ON|OFF | SHARE ON|OFF | SOURCE PROGRAMME|<output> | QR [ON|OFF] | PORT <n> | PIN <pin>|OFF (umsindo ufakiwe)

column1: Where highlights fold back through black. Low folds most of the picture, high folds only the brightest.
column2: Lapho ukukhanya kugoqeka kudlule ebumnyameni. Phansi kugoqa okuningi kwesithombe, phezulu okukhanya kakhulu kuphela.

column1: Where the band sits, 30Hz to 16kHz across the travel.
column2: Lapho ibhande likhona, 30Hz kuya ku-16kHz ekuhambeni konke.

column1: Where the fold sits: the middle at the left, toward the far edge to the right. Flips have no fold.
column2: Lapho ukugoqa kukhona: phakathi kwesobunxele, ngasonqenqemeni olukude kwesokudla. Ukuphendula akunakho ukugoqa.

column1: Where the light stands, in degrees around the frame.
column2: Lapho ukukhanya kumi khona, ngamadigri azungeze ifremu.

column1: Where the source sits around the listener, all the way round. For headphones -- it is a timing and shading trick, not a pan.
column2: Lapho umthombo ukhona nxazonke zomlaleli. Okwamahedfoni -- iqhinga lesikhathi nokufiphala, akuyona i-pan.

column1: Where the top ends, 200Hz to 20kHz. Pull it down to take the harshness off a bright source.
column2: Lapho okuphezulu kuphelela khona, 200Hz kuya ku-20kHz. Kwehlise ukususa ubukhali emthonjeni okhanyayo.

column1: Which channel the curve acts on: all three, then red, green or blue on its own -- the way a colourist warms or cools one end of the picture.
column2: Isiteshi ijika elisebenza kuso: zontathu, bese esibomvu, esiluhlaza noma esiluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka ngasinye -- njengomlungisi wombala oshisisa noma opholisa uhlangothi lwesithombe.

column1: Which way the knife edge lies. Only gradients ACROSS the edge show, so turning it swaps which features appear and which vanish.
column2: Indlela unqenqema lommese olumi ngayo. Kubonakala kuphela amagradiyenti ANQAMULAYO kulo, ukulujika kushintsha imininingwane evelayo nenyamalalayo.

column1: Which way the streak runs: across at the left, upright in the middle, across again at the right.
column2: Indlela umkhondo ogijima ngayo: uvundlile kwesobunxele, umile phakathi, uvundlile futhi kwesokudla.

column1: Widens the decision into a ramp, so edges keep their shape instead of jagging.
column2: Inweba umkhawulo ube ukushintsha okushelelayo, imiphetho igcine izimo zayo kunokuba namazinyo.

column1: Words to surface in the field, separated by | . One shows at a time, moving on the hold clock.
column2: Amagama azovela endaweni, ahlukaniswe ngo-| . Kuvela elilodwa ngesikhathi, kushintsha ngewashi lokubamba.

column1: Zero is one noise value across all three channels, which reads as film. Higher gives each channel its own, which reads as video.
column2: Uziro uyinani elilodwa lomsindo ongahlelekile kuzo zontathu iziteshi, kubukeke njengefilimu. Okuphezulu kunika ngasinye owako, kubukeke njengevidiyo.
